title: 第六章 社会的幽灵：社会主义国际主义、民生团与北朝鲜
originalTitle: Chapter Six · The Specter of the Social: Socialist Internationalism, the Minsaengdan, and North Korea

zh: 如前几章所讨论的，资本的逻辑与民族的逻辑作为两种不同却交织的原则汇聚在一起，塑造了满洲不同地区不平衡的社会关系。张作霖政府、朝鲜总督府与满洲国政府各自将各自的民族权力落实在社会领域。在每种情况下，民族臣民的塑造都体现了移民农民拥有土地、改善社会生活的愿望。民族的形成有赖于一项承诺，即建立新的生产和市场交换关系。私有财产制度是日本与中国两种政治框架内民族政治的堡垒。由此产生的社会关系是碎片化的，并导致地区与民族差距。1932年以前，朝鲜人在间岛因民族认同与自治而分裂；在满洲其他地方，他们与中国人对立。1932年后随着各群体被纳入农业合作社，朝鲜人、日本人与中国人发展出一种新等级，它构造了土地的交换与分配。
en: As discussed in the preceding chapters, the logic of capital and the logic of nation converged as two distinct yet intertwined principles to fashion uneven social relations in different regions of Manchuria. The Zhang Zuolin government, the Government General of Korea, and the Manchukuo government each inscribed its national power in the social sphere. In each case, the production of national subjects embodied the desire of migrant peasants to own land and improve their social lives. Nation formation was predicated on the promise of alternative social relations of production and market exchange. The private property system was the bastion of national politics within both the Japanese and Chinese political frameworks. The resulting social relations were fragmented and led to regional and national disparities. Prior to 1932, Koreans were divided over national identification and self-rule in Kando; in other parts of Manchuria, they were pitted against the Chinese. Through their integration into agricultural cooperatives after 1932, Koreans, Japanese, and Chinese developed a new hierarchy, which structured the exchange and distribution of land.

zh: 社会主义政治若要成功动员群众，就必须提供替代性的社会关系安排，能够切断农民与各种民族及殖民权力之间的纽带。新社会关系的可行性，取决于对组织社会关系的资本与民族这两种交织逻辑的同时批判。朝鲜与中国农民的统一，只有通过各自开展斗争，解决彼此之间及其内部的分化和对抗才能产生。这种统一不是预先决定的，而是在斗争中锻造的。由此产生的革命主体类型，本应在很大程度上保持不确定。然而，朝鲜与中国的共产主义者把满洲的革命主体构想为民族主体与阶级主体，其经验被预设为本质同质。随着共产主义者拥抱民族主义，满洲的社会主义国际主义成了民族政治的聚合，而非能够挑战资本主义生产与交换关系的全球性政治。当朝鲜与中国的共产主义者开展惯常形式的阶级斗争或抗日斗争时，他们把农民的社会阶级建构为绑定于民族国家的民族主体。例如，朝鲜移民无论其出身及与东北政府、日本的关系如何，都被界定为要么以朝鲜解放为先验关切的朝鲜国民，要么被期望与占多数的中国人共享利益、参加抗日革命斗争的少数族群。这种社会主义国际主义观，无力处理朝鲜与中国农民群体内部及之间那些需要多样、碎片化斗争的殊异社会关系。
en: If socialist politics were to succeed in mobilizing the masses, it would have to provide alternative arrangements of social relations that would be capable of severing the ties between peasants and the different national and colonial powers. The viability of new social relations hinged on the simultaneous critique of the intertwined logics of capital and nation that had organized social relations. The unity of Korean and Chinese peasants would arise only through discrete struggles capable of addressing their own fragmented and antagonistic relations. The unity would not be predetermined but was forged during the struggle. The resulting types of revolutionary subjects should have remained largely indeterminate. However, Korean and Chinese communists conceived revolutionary subjects in Manchuria as national and class subjects whose experiences were presumed to be essentially homogeneous. As the communists espoused nationalism, socialist internationalism in Manchuria became an aggregation of national politics rather than a global politics capable of challenging the capitalist relations of production and exchange. When Korean and Chinese communists undertook standard forms of class or anti-Japanese struggle, they construed social classes of peasants as national subjects bound to a nation-state. For instance, Korean migrants, regardless of their origins and relations with the Northeast government and Japan, were defined either as Korean nationals whose a priori concern was the liberation of Korea or as a minority that was expected to share the interests of the Chinese majority in engaging in an anti-Japanese revolutionary struggle. This conception of socialist internationalism was not equipped to tackle the disparate social relations within and between Korean and Chinese peasant groups, which required diverse and fragmented struggles.

zh: 1931年至1936年间，朝鲜共产主义者被扣上亲日组织民生团间谍的罪名，遭到中国共产党（中共）东满特别委员会及其组织的清洗。既有历史研究把清洗归因于中国共产主义者把朝鲜共产主义者当成替罪羊，以及对他们的歧视，以及把朝鲜革命任务从属于中国革命任务的中国民族主义。
据一项近期研究，把朝鲜人当作替罪羊发生在这样的背景下：不仅朝鲜共产主义者日益怀疑革命速胜，朝鲜群众也对游击解放区强制推行的激进改革感到幻灭。

我对这一文献的贡献在于双重主张：朝鲜民族主义与中国民族主义同样难辞其咎；清洗意味着社会的一种新生产。我考察中国与朝鲜两种民族主义，更重要的是它们对农民社会关系重组的塑造作用。清洗中朝鲜人的受害，是社会主义国际主义形成的一种特定社会观，朝鲜与中国的共产主义者都接受了这种看法的产物。清洗可以被理解为：在根本无法实现统一的情况下，试图塑造同质的主体，并给社会主义革命规定一个方向。清洗是徒劳地试图调和满洲极度不平衡的特性与单一集体社会体的虚幻前景。当民生团间谍被谴责为满洲朝鲜人自治的追求者时，自治政治其实植根于满洲地方社会条件，而这些条件不可化约为中国与朝鲜各自争取民族解放和社会主义解放的宏大目标。
en: Framed as spies of the Minsaengdan, a pro-Japanese organization, between 1931 and 1936 Korean communists were purged from the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee of the Chinese Communist Party (ccp) and its organizations. Existing historical studies attribute the purge to scapegoating and discrimination against Korean communists by Chinese communists and to a Chinese nationalism that subordinated the tasks of the Korean revolution to those of the Chinese revolution.

According to a recent study, the scapegoating of Koreans occurred in a context in which not just Korean communists were increasingly skeptical of the swiftness of making revolution but also the Korean masses were disenchanted with the radical reforms enforced in the liberated guerrilla bases.

My contribution to the literature lies in the double claim that Korean nationalism is just as liable as Chinese nationalism and that the purge signified a new production of the social. I explore both Chinese and Korean nationalism and, more importantly, their constitutive effects on the reorganization of peasants’ social relations. The victimization of Koreans in the purge was the product of a particular conception of the social that was formulated by socialist internationalism and shared by Korean and Chinese communists. The purge can be understood as an attempt to create homogeneous subjects and a singular direction for the socialist revolution, when ontological unity was impossible. The purge was a futile attempt to reconcile the vastly uneven character of Manchuria and the illusory prospect of a unitary collective social. When Minsaengdan spies were condemned as pursuers of Korean self-rule in Manchuria, the politics of self-rule was grounded in local social conditions in Manchuria that were irreducible to the larger objectives of national socialist liberation in China and Korea.

zh: 清洗中民生团的幽灵表明，社会关系的剩余无法被民族主义规定的社会框架所容纳。这个幽灵未必指朝鲜人对日本帝国主义的协助及日军日益增长的威胁。毋宁说，它是持续作祟的社会对抗——困扰着那些为其民族主义纲领与所代表人民的实际社会条件之间持久鸿沟而困惑的人。清洗主要发生在间岛，那里的反殖民革命运动超出了游击行动，动员了群众（主要是朝鲜农民）。它发生在革命力量扩张的顶峰之际。清洗的时空性表明，它关涉的不仅是共产主义者之间的民族主义冲突，还有动员群众、改造社会关系的革命任务。在某些方面，被指控的民生团间谍堪比“流浪的犹太人”——社会的外部敌人，因为犹太人与民生团成员都是社会统一的“终极保障”。据齐泽克所言：“从严格阶级斗争立场转向法西斯反犹主义时发生的，不只是以一种敌人形象（资产阶级、统治阶级）简单替换另一种（犹太人），而是从使社会体无从成立的对抗逻辑，转向保障社会体一致性的外部敌人逻辑。”
同样，清洗朝鲜人的运动并不只是以新敌人——民生团——替换朝鲜人反对地主、资产阶级与日本人的阶级斗争和民族斗争。它反而把朝鲜与中国的共产主义者、朝鲜农民与中共、朝鲜与中国的农民之间毫无裂隙的团结视为理所当然。
en: The specter of the Minsaengdan in the purge suggests that the surplus of social relations could not be contained by the nationalist prescription for the social. The specter did not necessarily refer to the Koreans’ assistance to Japanese imperialism and the mounting threats from Japanese armies. It was, rather, social antagonism that continued to haunt those who were perplexed by the persistent gap between their nationalist programs and the actual social conditions of the people they represented. The purge occurred mainly in Kando, where anticolonial revolutionary movements involved the masses (mainly Korean peasants) beyond guerrilla actions. It took place when the expansion of the revolutionary forces was at its peak. The spatiotemporality of the purge suggests that it concerned not merely the nationalist conflicts among communists but also the revolutionary tasks of mobilizing the masses and transforming social relations. In some ways, alleged Minsaengdan spies were comparable to “wandering Jews,” an external enemy of society in the sense that both Jews and Minsaengdan members were “the ultimate guarantee” of social unity. According to Žižek, “what happens in the passage from the position of strict class struggle to Fascist anti-Semitism is not just a simple replacement of one figure of the enemy (the bourgeoisie, the ruling class) with another (the Jews), but the shift from the logic of antagonism which makes Society impossible to the logic of external Enemy which guarantees Society’s consistency.”

Similarly the drive to purge Koreans did not simply replace the class and national struggle of Koreans against the landlords, bourgeoisie, and Japanese with a new enemy, the Minsaengdan. It instead naturalized the seamless unity of Korean and Chinese communists, Korean peasants and the ccp, and Korean and Chinese peasants.

zh: 本章首先探讨民生团的发展与反民生团斗争。然后把满洲与朝鲜人置于中共与朝鲜共产主义者殊异的民族政治之中，勾勒反民生团斗争对建构新社会关系的革命政治的意义。最后，我探讨清洗对后殖民时期北朝鲜革命的意涵——那场革命把满洲斗争奉为其起源。
en: This chapter begins by exploring the development of the Minsaengdan and the anti-Minsaengdan struggle. It then situates Manchuria and Koreans within the disparate national politics of the ccp and Korean communists and delineates the significance of the anti-Minsaengdan struggle for the revolutionary politics of constructing new social relations. Finally, I explore the implications of the purge for the North Korean revolution during the post-colonial period, which invoked the Manchurian struggle as its origin.

zh: 民生团
en: the minsaengdan

zh: 民生团（汉语 Minshengtuan）存在于1932年1月至7月。

在几位来自朝鲜的访客的倡议下——他们观察到满洲朝鲜人的脆弱处境——约一千人联合组成民生团。它存在于1931年9月九一八事变与1932年3月满洲国建立之间的过渡时期。与间岛其他朝鲜人自治运动一样，它也把获得民族成员身份、改善农民社会生活视为朝鲜人自治的基础。民生团取代了自治促进委员会（Chach'i ch'okchin wiwŏnhoe）——九一八事变后地方政府臣服于日本权力，该会遂放弃对东北政府的支持。

在1932年2月15日的成立大会上，民生团宣布其主要目标：在即将建立的满蒙国家中获得国民资格（朝鲜语 kongmin'gwŏn，汉语“公民权”，原书拼作 gongminqun）；为朝鲜人建立自治区域；推进经济发展计划，包括创造自耕农、运营农民组合、扩展信用与金融组织。民生团徒劳地向满洲国政权请求：间岛行政机关应归满洲国政权而非吉林省政府管辖；应任命朝鲜人在该机关任职，以反映朝鲜人是间岛最大族群的事实；县级以下行政单位应由当地居民管理。
en: The Minsaengdan (Minshengtuan in Chinese) existed from January to July of 1932.

Following the initiatives of a few visitors from Korea, who observed the vulnerable conditions of Koreans in Manchuria, about one thousand people joined together to form the Minsaengdan. It existed in an interstitial moment between the Manchuria Incident in September 1931 and the establishment of the Manchukuo state in March 1932. Like other Korean self-rule movements in Kando, it also saw the acquisition of national membership and the improvement of the social lives of peasants as the foundation of self-rule for Koreans. The Minsaengdan replaced the Association to Facilitate Self-Rule (Chach’i ch’okchin wiwŏnhoe), which had abandoned its support for the Northeast government as local governments submitted to Japanese power after the Manchuria Incident.

At its inaugural meeting on February 15, 1932, the Minsaengdan declared its main objectives: the acquisition of national membership (kongmin’gwŏn in Korean, gongminqun in Chinese) in the imminent state in Manchuria and Mongolia; the establishment of an autonomous area for Koreans; and the promotion of plans for economic development, including the creation of independent farmers, the operation of farmers’ unions, and the expansion of credit and financial organizations. The Minsaengdan fruitlessly requested of the Manchukuo state that the Kando Administration be placed under the jurisdiction of the Manchukuo state, not the Jilin provincial government; that Koreans be appointed to serve in the Kando Administration, reflecting the fact that Koreans were the largest ethnic group in Kando; and that local residents run administrative units below the county level.

zh: 民生团的发展脉络表明，朝鲜人自治是问题的核心。起初，它得到日本外务省、日本驻满洲领事馆与朝鲜总督府的支持。这种短暂支持与九一八事变后日本采取的政策一致。日本扶植蒙古人与中国人的自决运动，以使他们同时脱离南京政府与张学良领导的东北政府。日本对朝鲜人自决的支持，是一种殖民策略，旨在使他们脱离满洲相互竞争的民族权力。满洲朝鲜人自治运动最热心的支持者是朝鲜总督府。朝鲜总督府主动在朝日双语的《间岛新报》（Kandosinbo）上撰文，宣称间岛是朝鲜的一部分，并主张其捍卫朝鲜人利益的权利。朝鲜总督府警务局长表达了他的热情：“间岛作为朝鲜的延伸，应被指定为特别行政区，设与朝鲜相似的政府组织；若在间岛建立与朝鲜相似的行政机构，将既适合新生的满蒙国家，也适合朝鲜总督府。”
朝鲜总督府计划组织满蒙委员会，以设立行政单位、派遣朝鲜人官员、支持朝鲜人移居满洲。它期望统治间岛的朝鲜人，而不是把他们置于未来满蒙国家的主权之下。然而，在关东军的反对下，朝鲜总督府迅速撤回了对朝鲜人自治的支持。
en: The genealogy of the Minsaengdan demonstrates that Korean self-rule was at the heart of the issue. At first, it received support from the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Japanese consulates in Manchuria, and the Government General of Korea. This momentary support was in alignment with the Japanese policy adopted in the aftermath of the Manchuria Incident. Japan bolstered the self-determination movements of the Mongols and Chinese in order to separate them from both the Nanjing government and the Northeast government headed by Zhang Xueliang. Japan’s support for self-determination for Koreans was a colonial strategy meant to separate them from the competing national powers in Manchuria. The most ardent supporter of the Korean self-rule movement in Manchuria was the Government General of Korea. In an unsolicited article in the Kandosinbo, a Kando newspaper published in both Korean and Japanese, the Government General of Korea declared Kando to be part of Korea and asserted its right to defend the interests of Koreans. The head of the police department of the Government General of Korea expressed his enthusiasm: “As an extension of Korea, Kando should be designated as a special administrative area with a governmental organization similar to that of Korea, and it would suit both the emergent state of Manchuria-Mongolia and the Government General of Korea if an administration similar to that of Korea were to be established in Kando.”

The Government General of Korea planned to organize a Committee on Manchuria-Mongolia to establish administrative units, dispatch Korean officials, and support the emigration of Koreans to Manchuria. It expected to rule over the Koreans in Kando rather than placing them under the sovereignty of the prospective state of Manchuria and Mongolia. Upon the objection of the Kwantung Army, however, the Government General of Korea quickly withdrew its support for Korean self-rule.

zh: 日本间岛总领事对间岛将成为朝鲜一部分的想法，比朝鲜总督府更为谨慎。总领事对民生团组织者的最初提案表示保留，尤其是他们倡导的“朝鲜人的自由世界”——这暗示主张朝鲜与间岛独立。只有在创始人两次修改其自治声明后，总领事才批准民生团。在最新文本中，间岛与满洲作为朝鲜一部分的想法被放弃，而自卫、独立、自治等口号仍具象征性。新文本强调由民生团推动朝鲜人生计的“产业化”，并把这类活动限于间岛。民生团宣称的目标在1932年3月再次修改。这一次，日本外务省反对间岛的朝鲜人自治。它担心在间岛为朝鲜人自治设立特殊政府，会使间岛脱离新建立的满洲国。作为回应，民生团组织者把目标从促进“由间岛40万朝鲜人领导的特殊行政组织”，改为“特别自治区域设定”（朝鲜语 t'ukpyŏl chach'i kuyŏk，汉语 tebie zizhi quyu sheding），再改为“自治领”（朝鲜语 chach'iryŏng，汉语 zizhiling），最后改为满洲国管辖下的“特别行政区”（朝鲜语 t'ukpyŏl haengjŏnggu，汉语 tebie xingzhengqu）。为消除满洲国的疑虑，提案强调朝鲜人与中国人的和谐关系。
en: The Japanese consul general in Kando was more cautious than the Government General of Korea about the idea that Kando would be part of Korea. The Japanese consul general registered his reservations about the initial proposal of the Minsaengdan organizers, especially their promotion of a “free world for Koreans,” which implied advocacy for the independence of Korea and Kando. The consul general gave his approval to the Minsaengdan only after its founders twice revised its statements on self-rule. In the latest measure, the idea of Kando and Manchuria as part of Korea was dropped, while such catchphrases as self-defense, independence, and autonomy continued to be emblematic. Emphasis was added to the promotion by the Minsaengdan of the “industrialization” of Korean life and the restriction of such activities to Kando. The stated objectives of the Minsaengdan underwent further revision in March 1932. This time the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs opposed Korean self-rule in Kando. It feared that the creation of a special government for Korean self-rule in Kando would separate it from the newly created Manchukuo state. In response, the Minsaengdan organizers changed their goals from the promotion of “a special administrative organization led by 400,000 Koreans in Kando,” to “a specific district for self-rule” (t’ukpyŏl chach’i kuyŏk in Korean, tebie zizhi quyu sheding in Chinese), to “a special area for self-rule” (chach’iryŏng in Korean, zizhiling in Chinese), and finally to a “special administrative unit” (t’ukpyŏl haengjŏnggu in Korean, tebie xingzhengqu in Chinese) under the jurisdiction of the Manchukuo state. To allay Manchukuo’s misgivings, the proposal underscored the harmonious relations between Koreans and Chinese.

zh: 朝鲜人自治问题间歇性地得到日本的支持，直到1932年5月最终被拒绝。关东军1932年4月3日发布的关于间岛治安与统治的指导方针，强调关东军与朝鲜总督府及其朝鲜军之间的分工。关东军监督行政、任命官员与顾问，采纳朝鲜总督府的推荐。朝鲜总督府维持治安、监督地方官员与团体。指导方针既未提及朝鲜人自治，也不包含在间岛设立特殊行政单位的任何计划。1932年4月7日，日本外务大臣把朝鲜人自治问题划归满洲国吉林省而非朝鲜总督府管辖。然而一个月后，它却命令民生团终止自治运动。直到1932年7月关闭办事处，民生团的主要活动仅限于欢迎日军进入满洲、为自卫团训练朝鲜人。即便是后者也只持续了十天，因为满洲国接管了地方防卫团的监督。但即便在1932年10月正式解散之后，民生团仍是间岛共产主义运动内部动荡的由头。
en: The issue of Korean self-rule received intermittent endorsement from Japan until it was finally rejected in May 1932. The guidelines of the Kwantung Army on the security and governing of Kando that were issued on April 3, 1932, emphasized a division of labor between the Kwantung Army and the Government General of Korea and its Korean Army. The Kwantung Army would oversee administration and appoint officials and advisers, taking recommendations from the Government General of Korea. The Government General of Korea would maintain security and supervise local officials and associations. The guidelines neither mentioned self-rule of Koreans nor included any plan to create a special administrative unit in Kando. On April 7, 1932, the head of the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs delegated the issue of Korean self-rule to the jurisdiction of the Jilin Province of the Manchukuo state and not to the Government General of Korea. However, a month later it ordered the Minsaengdan to terminate the self-rule movement. Until it closed its offices in July 1932, the Minsaengdan’s main activities were limited to welcoming Japanese armies to Manchuria and training Koreans for the self-defense corps. Even the latter lasted only ten days, as the Manchukuo took over the supervision of the local defense corps. But even after its formal dissolution in October 1932, the Minsaengdan wreaked havoc in communist politics in Kando.

zh: 反民生团斗争
en: the anti-minsaengdan struggle

zh: 随着时间推移，民生团与中共之间产生紧张。民生团动员保守的朝鲜人反对共产主义，中共则发起对民生团的批判。中共断言，民生团由朝鲜人地主、富农、高利贷者与商人领导。在中共满洲省委的指示下，中共东满特别委员会——辖间岛四县及另外两县（安图与敦化）——从1932年10月至1936年2月开展肃清民生团残余渗透势力的斗争。满洲省委（mpc）把反民生团斗争（下文简称“斗争”）转化为针对本党党员及其抗日组织的总体战。随着满洲省委追查民生团对间岛中共每个单位的渗透，几乎所有人都被牵连为民生团间谍。1934年满洲省委派往东满特委的一位党员观察到：
en: Over time, tension developed between the Minsaengdan and the ccp. The Minsaengdan mobilized conservative Koreans in opposition to communism, while the ccp launched critiques of the Minsaengdan. The ccp asserted that the Minsaengdan was led by Korean landlords, rich peasants, usurers, and merchants. Under the instructions of the Manchuria Provincial Committee of the ccp, the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee of the ccp, which comprised four counties in Kando and two others (Ando and Tonhwa), engaged in a struggle against the infiltrated remnants of the Minsaengdan from October 1932 to February 1936. The Manchurian Provincial Committee (mpc) translated the anti-Minsaengdan struggle (hereafter “the struggle”) into a total war against members of its own party and its anti-Japanese organizations. As the mpc traced the Minsaengdan’s infiltration into every unit of the ccp in Kando, it implicated almost everyone as Minsaengdan spies. A party member dispatched by the mpc to the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee in 1934 observed:

zh: 民生团组织利用我们［中共］的组织发展他们自己的组织，借我们的通信系统建立他们的通信系统，并利用我们的巡逻系统侦察我们对他们的斗争。因此，我们的委员会变成了他们的委员会。我们的县委、区委与支部，分别变成了他们的县委、区委与支部。东满[间岛]的民生团成员，至少占我们全党、党组织、人民革命军及各种群众组织的50%或60%。
en: The Minsaengdan organization has used our [ccp] organization to develop its own organization, appropriated our communications systems to develop their own communication systems, and exploited our own patrol system to detect our struggle against them. Therefore, our committee has become their committee. Our county committees, district committees, and branches have become their county committees, district committees, and their branches, respectively. The Minsaengdan members in East Manchuria [Kando] comprise at least 50 or 60 percent of all our party, party organizations, people’s revolutionary armies, and various mass organizations.

zh: 随着中共把斗争变成群众运动，调查与追究从东满特委的高级干部蔓延到普通党员，从游击队指挥员蔓延到几乎所有人，包括游击根据地的老人、妇女与儿童。1934年末，满洲省委的一位代表观察到，即便经过一年成功的反民生团斗争，中共的游击根据地仍继续充当民生团的温床。据他估计，民生团成员平均渗透了约70%的党及其群众组织、约50%的青年团。
满洲省委花了近两年才认识到这种诡异评估的闹剧性质：1935年年中，满洲省委的一位成员指出反民生团斗争的严重夸大，他说，如果民生团成员占间岛游击根据地人口的60%或70%以上，日军早就摧毁这些根据地了。
en: As the ccp turned the struggle into a mass movement, the investigation and prosecution spread from top cadres to rank and file members of the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee and from commanders of guerrilla armies to almost everyone, including the elderly, women, and children in guerrilla bases. In late 1934, a representative from the mpc observed that the guerrilla bases of the ccp continued to serve as breeding grounds for the Minsaengdan, even after one year of successful anti-Minsaengdan struggle. In his estimate, on average Minsaengdan members had infiltrated about 70 percent of the party and its mass organizations and about 50 percent of the youth corps.

It took almost two years for the mpc to recognize the farce in such an uncanny assessment: In mid-1935, a member of the mpc pointed out the great exaggeration of the anti-Minsaengdan struggle, saying that if Minsaengdan members constituted more than 60 or 70 percent of people in guerrilla bases in Kando, Japan must have already destroyed them.

zh: 三年反民生团间谍的斗争，削减了朝鲜人在中共东满特委中的代表比例。1931年4月斗争之前，间岛的东满特委有636名党员，除18人外全是朝鲜人。

1933年9月东满特委党员扩展到965人时，朝鲜人的比例也从96.5%增至97.9%。这种倾向也盛行于其他共产主义组织，如朝鲜人占多数的共产主义青年团。斗争中被清洗的朝鲜人数，估计从数百到数千不等。恐惧使2,000多人（除47人外全是朝鲜人）在1934年9月至1936年3月间投奔日军。1935年5月东满特委整编革命军时，朝鲜人在领导层与普通士兵两个层面的数量都大幅缩减。总共八个部队单位的领导层中，只剩两名朝鲜人，其中包括解放后时期成为北朝鲜领导人的金日成。总共1,200名普通士兵中，朝鲜人仅占50%至60%。

children: 〔校注〕1931 年 636 人中若除 18 人，朝鲜人约占 97.2%。正文所列的 96.5% 仍照原书。

en: The three-year struggle against the Minsaengdan spies curtailed the representation of Koreans in the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee of the ccp. Before the struggle in April 1931, the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee in Kando had 636 members, all but 18 of whom were Korean.

When the membership of the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee expanded to 965 members in September 1933, the representation of Koreans also increased from 96.5 to 97.9 percent. This tendency also prevailed in other communist organizations, such as the Communist Youth Organization, in which Koreans comprised the majority. Estimates of the number of Koreans purged during the struggle range from several hundred to thousands. Fear induced more than 2,000 (all Korean except for 47) to defect to the Japanese armies between September 1934 and March 1936. When the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee regrouped its revolutionary army in May 1935, the number of enlisted Koreans had shrunk significantly at the levels of both the leadership and the rank and file. Only two Koreans, including Kim Il Sung, who emerged as the leader of North Korea in the postliberation period, remained in the leadership in a total of eight army units. Koreans comprised only 50 to 60 percent of the total of 1,200 rank and file members.

zh: 对朝鲜人的清洗，无异于中共摧毁自己在间岛的组织。间岛革命斗争的削弱危及中共在满洲全境开展活动的能力，因为朝鲜人是东满特委——间岛组织最好的单位——的骨干。三年以民生团为名的清查，加上日本的平定计划与农业合作社的建立，瓦解了间岛的游击根据地。失去朝鲜农民的帮助，游击队无法购买衣物、食品或其他必需品。一位见证者生动描述了斗争的后果：“从前我们买什么都容易，只是钱不够；现在有钱，却无处买东西。从前人多枪少；现在枪多人少。从前我们通常住在村里，现在却总在山上转移[以躲避日本人]。从前我们容易知道敌人的行踪，现在敌人却容易探知我们的活动。”
en: The purge of Koreans was equivalent to the ccp’s destruction of its own organization in Kando. The weakening of the revolutionary struggle in Kando threatened the ccp’s capacity in Manchuria as a whole because Koreans constituted the backbone of the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee, the best-organized unit in Kando. The three-year witch-hunt against the Minsaengdan, together with Japan’s pacification program and the establishment of agrarian cooperatives, dissolved the guerrilla bases in Kando. Lacking help from Korean peasants, the guerrilla armies could not purchase clothing, food, or other necessities. One witness dramatized the effects of the struggle: “Before it was easy for us to purchase anything, but we did not have enough money; now, we have money but lack places to purchase goods. Before, we had plenty of people but not guns; now we have a lot of guns without people. Before, we usually stayed in villages, but now we are always moving in the mountains [to escape the Japanese]. Before, we easily knew the whereabouts of our enemies, but now our enemies easily learn of our activities.”

zh: 斗争在民生团正式解散之后仍与其幽灵作战。Lee Chong Sik 把这场斗争归因于让朝鲜人为群众动员的失败承担责任。1932年东满特委组织红军、建立苏维埃政府时，力图招募从亲满洲国首领那里叛逃的中国士兵，并动员群众。但中国共产主义者对地主的激进政策，以及特委以朝鲜人为主的状况，使许多中国人对他们敬而远之。当日本的平定行动迫使共产主义者退入延吉、汪清、珲春三县的腹地时，他们在1932年11月至1933年2月间组织了五个苏维埃区，涵盖4,100人。但这些苏维埃区所能争取的基本只有躲避日本镇压的难民和离开农业合作社的人。苏维埃政府还苦于成员日益增多的叛逃。在这些背景下，朝鲜共产主义者被指控为民生团间谍与派系分子，其无谓的内斗与分裂破坏了组织统一，削弱了对日本渗透的防御。
en: The struggle battled with the specter of the Minsaengdan after its formal dissolution. Lee Chong Sik attributes the struggle to the scapegoating of Koreans for the failure of mass mobilization. When the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee organized a red army and created soviet governments in 1932, it sought to recruit Chinese soldiers that had deserted pro-Manchukuo leaders and to mobilize the masses. But many Chinese were estranged from the radical policies of the Chinese communists toward landlords and the predominantly Korean makeup of the committee. When Japanese pacification forced the communists to retreat into the hinterlands in Yon’gil, Wangch’ong, and Hunch’un Counties, they organized five soviet districts, encompassing 4,100 persons, between November 1932 and February 1933. But the soviet districts served little more than refugees from Japanese suppression and deserters from the agricultural cooperatives. The soviet governments also suffered from the increasing desertion of its members. In these contexts, Korean communists were accused of being Minsaengdan spies and factionalists, whose senseless infighting and secessions undermined organizational unity and weakened its defense against Japanese infiltration.

zh: 在或许迄今最全面的斗争研究中，朝鲜族学者金成镐（Kim Songho）探讨了斗争的两个重要特征：集中于东满，以及朝鲜人的参与。金成镐把这些特征归因于中国共产主义领导层的特性、亲日群体的族群与民族构成，更重要的是朝鲜人与中国人彼此的族群与民族偏见。南满没有发生这场斗争，部分原因是朝鲜人人数较少，亲日的嫌疑也较小。此外，南满的中国共产主义领导层比东满更坚持国际主义，与朝鲜人结合得更紧密。

在东满，朝鲜人占多数，长期被怀疑充当日本帝国主义的先锋。此外，即便在朝鲜共产主义者与革命群众构成中国共产主义组织骨干的地方，他们的中国同志仍歧视他们。语言、风俗等民族差异，妨碍了革命力量中朝鲜人与中国人的沟通。把中文文件译成朝鲜文的困难，延误了朝鲜人对满洲省委命令的执行，并助长了对其忠诚的怀疑。朝鲜革命者不能说流利中文，以及包括饮食习惯在内的日常风俗，使他们不愿与游击队中的中国同志密切共事——在那里他们同住同睡同吃。当人们恐惧民生团成员渗透共产主义组织时，朝鲜人的风俗煽起了对他们的不信任。为了摆脱作为外国人的低下地位，朝鲜革命者热切地参加了斗争。

children: 〔校注〕金成镐（Kim Songho，谚文 김성호），延边大学历史系教授，著《1930年代延边民生团事件研究》（白山资料院）。原注中拼作 Kim Sŏngho，为同一人。

en: In perhaps the most comprehensive study of the struggle to date, Kim Songho, a Korean Chinese scholar, explores two important features of the struggle: its concentration in East Manchuria and the participation of Koreans. Kim credits these features to characteristics of the Chinese communist leadership, the ethnic and national composition of the pro-Japanese group, and, more importantly, the ethnic and national prejudices of Koreans and Chinese toward each other. The struggle did not take place in South Manchuria, not only because Koreans were too few to be suspected of being pro-Japanese. It was because the Chinese communist leadership espoused more internationalism than in East Manchuria and integrated the Koreans more closely.

In East Manchuria, Koreans were in the majority and had long been suspected of spearheading Japanese imperialism. Furthermore, even where Korean communists and the revolutionary masses constituted the backbone of Chinese communist organizations, their Chinese comrades discriminated against them. National differences, such as those of language and customs, inhibited communication between Koreans and Chinese in the revolutionary forces. The difficulty of translating Chinese documents into Korean delayed the execution of mpc orders by Koreans and fueled suspicions about their loyalty. The inability of Korean revolutionaries to speak fluent Chinese and their everyday customs, including their eating habits, discouraged them from working closely with their Chinese comrades in guerrilla armies, where they lived, slept, and ate in close proximity. When the penetration of the Minsaengdan members into communist organizations was feared, the customs of Koreans fanned the mistrust of them. In order to shed their inferior position as foreigners, Korean revolutionaries earnestly took part in the struggle.

zh: 韩国学者 Lee Chongsŏk 与 Shin Chubaek 主张，斗争源于中国民族主义——这是比诿过与文化偏见更深层、较少受偶然因素支配的成因。中国民族主义使中国革命的目标与解放朝鲜、在朝鲜革命的目标对立。据 Lee Chongsŏk 所言，民族主义使中国共产主义者把朝鲜人争取自治的倡议解读为旨在使朝鲜人疏离中国革命的举动。
对 Shin Chubaek 而言，中国民族主义促使中国共产主义者把朝鲜共产主义者解放朝鲜的愿望视为朝鲜民族主义的例证，从而视为对社会主义国际主义的违背。

children: 〔校注〕Lee Chong Sik（이정식）与 Lee Chongsŏk（이종석）为两位不同学者：前者与斯卡拉皮诺合著《朝鲜共产主义史》（Communism in Korea, 1972）；后者研究北朝鲜指导集团与抗日武装斗争。本书各照原拼写保留，不予统一。Shin Chubaek 谚文 신주백，著《满洲地区韩人的民族运动史（1920–1945）》。

en: South Korean scholars Lee Chongsŏk and Shin Chubaek contend that the struggle originated with Chinese nationalism, which is a more profound and less circumstantial origin than scapegoating and cultural prejudices. Chinese nationalism pitted the goal of a Chinese revolution against the goal of liberating Korea and making a revolution there. According to Lee Chongsŏk, nationalism led Chinese communists to interpret the initiative of Koreans for self-rule as a move intended to estrange Koreans from the Chinese revolution.

For Shin Chubaek, Chinese nationalism prompted Chinese communists to regard Korean communists’ desire to liberate Korea as an illustration of Korean nationalism and thus a violation of socialist internationalism.

zh: 下文的讨论进一步探讨中国与朝鲜形式的民族主义，尤其是它们的构成，以及它们为满洲规定新社会关系时遭遇的陷阱。
en: The following discussion further explores the Chinese and Korean forms of nationalism, particularly their composition and the pitfalls they encountered in prescribing new social relations for Manchuria.

zh: 当中国共产主义者谴责民生团渗透者促进朝鲜人自治时，自治恰恰集中体现了对当地朝鲜农民社会处境的关切。间岛的各种自治运动，包括民生团推动的那一场，都承诺稳固的土地所有权与替代性的生产、市场交换模式。换言之，耕作与土地所有权的社会关切塑造了朝鲜农民的政治。自治倡议不同于中共与满洲省委所认可的威尔逊式民族自决观念。朝鲜人自治运动处理朝鲜农民的社会条件，中国共产主义者却只追求政治独立。中国共产主义者的朝鲜民族自决政策，承诺加入建构独立朝鲜国家的斗争。这一朝鲜民族自决政策把满洲朝鲜人描绘为少数族群或日本掌控下的流亡者。它遮蔽了朝鲜农民与日本资本之间持久的社会纽带——正是这种纽带产生了朝鲜人与中国人之间复杂的社会关系。
en: When the Chinese communists censured the Minsaengdan infiltrators for promoting Korean self-rule, self-rule epitomized the concerns for the local social conditions of Korean peasants. Various self-rule movements in Kando, including the one promoted by the Minsaengdan, promised secure landownership and alternative models of production and market exchange. In other words, social concerns of cultivation and landownership shaped the politics of Korean peasants. The initiatives for self-rule differed from the Wilsonian notion of self-determination endorsed by the ccp and the mpc. While the Korean self-rule movement tackled the social conditions of Korean peasants, the Chinese communists merely pursued political independence. The Chinese communists’ policy of Korean self-determination pledged to join the struggle for the construction of an independent Korean state. This policy of Korean self-determination portrayed Koreans of Manchuria as ethnic minorities or exiles under the Japanese thumb. It obscured the enduring social ties between Korean peasants and Japanese capital, which produced complex social relations between Koreans and Chinese.

zh: 在中共的反民生团斗争中，自治成了一个指代词，指向中国与朝鲜共产主义者都无法表述的社会现实。中国与朝鲜共产主义者的路径，与他们殊异的民族主义不可分离——后者分别把满洲视为中国的一部分和朝鲜的延伸。他们的路径使他们无法理解满洲社会关系中的地区与民族差距。对自治的谴责，把共产主义者无力处理间岛社会现实这一点外部化了。清洗使中国与朝鲜共产主义者得以把同质性强加于中国与朝鲜农民——后者的经验因其与东北政府及日本权力的不同纽带而碎片化。

children: 〔校注〕原文把“中国与朝鲜共产主义者”与“朝鲜的延伸及中国的一部分”依次相配。此处按本章随后两节的论述，将中国方面配“中国的一部分”、朝鲜方面配“朝鲜的延伸”。

en: In the ccp’s anti-Minsaengdan struggle, self-rule became a signifier of the social that both Chinese and Korean communists could not articulate. The approaches of Chinese and Korean communists were inseparable from their disparate nationalisms, which cast Manchuria as an extension of Korea and part of China, respectively. Their approaches prevented them from understanding the regional and national disparities in social relations in Manchuria. Condemnation of self-rule externalized the inability of the communists to address the social reality of Kando. The purge allowed both the Chinese and Korean communists to impose homogeneity on Chinese and Korean peasants, whose experiences were fragmented by their differing ties with the Northeast government and Japanese power.

zh: 中国共产主义者的民族主义
en: chinese communist nationalism

zh: 中国共产党成立五年后，于1927年10月在南满沈阳建立了满洲省委。满洲省委监督满洲的中国共产主义组织与活动。满洲省委的创建，标志着中共力图加强与地方干部的联系、加强满洲共产主义组织。然而，直到1930年初满洲朝鲜共产主义者加入中共，共产主义力量才经历切实的扩张。1927年，满洲的中国共产主义力量仅有173名干部；他们组织工农、争取支持的能力有限。据一项日本估计，间岛的中共党员有3,800名朝鲜人与150名中国人。
朝鲜共产主义者的加入增强了中共的群众基础。占共产主义阵营90%以上的朝鲜共产主义者，领导了城市农民暴动，并发起对日本设施的袭击。

children: 〔校注〕本段将中共成立至 1927 年 10 月的间隔写作“五年”。按 1921 年成立计，间隔约六年。

en: Five years after the Chinese Communist Party was formed, it established the Manchurian Provincial Committee in October 1927 in Shenyang in South Manchuria. The mpc oversaw Chinese communist organizations and activities in Manchuria. The creation of the mpc marked an attempt by the ccp to facilitate communications with local cadres and strengthen communist organizations in Manchuria. However, it was not until Korean communists in Manchuria joined the ccp in early 1930 that the communist forces experienced a concrete expansion. In 1927, the Chinese communist forces in Manchuria amounted to a mere 173 cadres; they had a limited capacity to organize and enlist support from workers and peasants. According to one Japanese estimate, ccp members in Kando numbered 3,800 Koreans and 150 Chinese.

The admission of Korean communists enhanced the mass basis of the ccp. Korean communists, who comprised more than 90 percent of the communist constituency, led peasant riots in the cities and launched attacks on Japanese facilities.

zh: 满洲中国共产主义力量中朝鲜人占如此大的比重，给满洲省委提出了难题——其中国民族主义在1920年代末变得清晰。满洲省委民族主义的一个主要成分，是把满洲与朝鲜人同化进中华民族。对满洲共产主义活动的历史研究，主要聚焦于满洲与中国的纽带，把它当作满洲省委、中共与共产国际之间判断三方权力关系如何变化的依据。
1933年以前，称为李立三路线的激进阶级斗争政策，否定了中共此前的立场——例如在1928年6月共产国际第六次代表大会上，中共曾承认中国经济被认为不够发达，以及日本帝国主义正向满洲扩张等情况。中共1933年1月的一项指示以抗日斗争取代阶级斗争，以应对满洲的特殊条件。我把对满洲的各种不同表述置于中国民族主义的不同形态中考察，因为这些形态塑造了朝鲜与中国共产主义者的关系。

children: 〔校注〕原书将共产国际第六次代表大会写作 1928 年 6 月。该次大会于同年 7 月至 9 月在莫斯科举行。

en: This large component of Koreans in the Chinese communist forces in Manchuria posed problems for the mpc, whose Chinese nationalism came into focus in the late 1920s. A main component of the mpc’s nationalism included the assimilation of Manchuria and Koreans into the Chinese nation. Historical studies of communist activities in Manchuria have mainly focused on the link between Manchuria and China, taking it as the indicator of the shifting hierarchy of the mpc, the ccp, and the Comintern.

Prior to 1933, a radical policy of class struggle, called the Li Li-san line, refuted the previous position of the ccp, which, in the Sixth Congress of the Comintern in June 1928, for example, accepted conditions in China such as the putatively underdeveloped economy and the advance of Japanese imperialism in Manchuria. A directive of the ccp in January 1933 replaced class struggle with the anti-Japanese struggle in order to address the specific conditions in Manchuria. I situate the variant representations of Manchuria within the formations of Chinese nationalism, which shaped the relations of Korean and Chinese communists.

zh: 1933年以前的中国、满洲与朝鲜人
en: China, Manchuria, and Koreans Prior to 1933

zh: 中共的立三路线要求在全国统一开展反资本主义的阶级斗争，1929年10月以后尤其如此。它把国民党地主与富农认定为革命的敌人，誓言废除私有财产。在国民党进攻之后，上海的中共中央把反国民党斗争置于抗日行动之上。这一政策与共产国际不刺激日本的政策一致。1931年日本占领满洲之前，共产国际对日本推行顺从的外交关系，以维持日本对苏联的外交承认，并让苏联继续控制中东铁路。立三路线很快因未能兼顾抗日斗争与农民的土地所有权愿望而受到批评。即便中共1931年1月正式否定立三路线之后，阶级斗争直到1932年仍是中共的首要焦点。
en: The Li Li-san line of the ccp policies promulgated a uniform policy of anticapitalist class struggle across China, especially after October 1929. It identified the Kuomintang landlords and rich peasants as the enemies of the revolution and vowed to abolish private property. After attacks by the Kuomintang, the ccp’s Central Committee in Shanghai prioritized the anti-Kuomintang struggle over anti-Japanese actions. This policy was in accord with the Comintern’s policy not to provoke Japan. Before Japan’s occupation of Manchuria in 1931, the Comintern pursued compliant diplomatic relations with Japan in order to maintain Japanese recognition of the Soviet Union and retain Soviet control over the Chinese Eastern Railway. The Li Lisan line was soon criticized for its failure to accommodate both the anti-Japanese struggle and the desire of peasants for landownership. Even after the ccp formally repudiated the Li Li-san line in January 1931, class struggle remained the primary focus of the ccp until 1932.

zh: 关于满洲共产主义的文献描述了中共与满洲省委在满洲政策上反复出现的紧张。

标准革命政策使中共压制满洲的历史特殊性。由于满洲省委在革命斗争中纳入对日本帝国主义的批判时得不到中共的支持，它倾向于站在共产国际一边——后者在1920年代末与日本帝国权力的冲突日益加剧。然而，这种对满洲共产主义政治的看法，忽视了满洲省委认为日本帝国主义在满洲扩张程度之深是当地独有的特点的具体认识。实际上，满洲省委代表继续反思满洲条件，却未与中共政策产生尖锐紧张。因为满洲省委是在阶级斗争框架内理解满洲条件的。在它看来，满洲的阶级矛盾与民族矛盾相重合。日本帝国主义与中国资产阶级及军阀勾结剥削工农，在满洲加剧了灾难性的资本主义危机。张作霖及其亲信是最大的地主与最有权势的商人。东北政府拥有的官方资本构成满洲的支配资本。这种对满洲的描绘，把所有地主、军阀、民族资产阶级与日本帝国主义者归为一类，当作工人、佃农与农业劳工的共同敌人。
en: The literature on communism in Manchuria describes the recurring tensions between the ccp and the mpc over the policy on Manchuria.

The standard revolutionary policy led the ccp to suppress the historical specificity of Manchuria. As the mpc failed to receive the support of the ccp in accommodating the critique of Japanese imperialism in its revolutionary struggle, it tended to take sides with the Comintern, which increasingly clashed with Japanese imperial power in the late 1920s. However, such a view of communist politics in Manchuria ignores the mpc’s specific understanding of advanced Japanese imperialism as a unique feature in Manchuria. In actuality, the mpc representatives continued to reflect on Manchurian conditions but without developing acute tension over the ccp’s policy. For the mpc comprehended Manchurian conditions within the framework of class struggle. In its opinion, class contradictions coincided with national contradictions in Manchuria. Japanese imperialism had furthered a catastrophic capitalist crisis in Manchuria, teaming up with the Chinese bourgeoisie and the warlords to exploit peasants and workers. Zhang Zuolin and his close associates were the largest landlords and the most powerful merchants. The official capital owned by the Northeast government constituted the dominant capital in Manchuria. This portrayal of Manchuria lumped together all landlords, warlords, the national bourgeoisie, and Japanese imperialists as the common enemies of workers, tenants, and farm laborers.

zh: 尤其值得注意的是，满洲省委把世界性资本主义经济萧条认定为满洲经济危机的主要原因。货币价值暴跌，包括农作物与加工食品在内的农产品出口也骤减，农民收入随之下降。铁路公司与其他运输业同样经历衰退，导致工人被解雇、工资被削减。农民在各种税负与地主剥削（如加租与贷款高息）的重压下受苦。军阀、民族资产阶级与日本帝国主义加剧了群众的苦难。受军阀控制的东北政府，有各种从耕作者手中窃取土地的手段，例如故意丈量错误、提出土地所有者难以达到的产权举证要求。东北政府与民族资产阶级还与日本帝国权力勾结，剥削农民、工人与小商人。日本商人控制约60%的零售店铺。日本人还经营南满铁路、矿山与各种工厂，同时继续聚敛农田。
基于对满洲经济状况的这一评估，满洲省委把资本家、地主与资产阶级归入工农阶级敌人的范畴。
en: In particular, the mpc identified the worldwide capitalist economic depression as the primary cause of the economic crisis in Manchuria. The value of currencies plummeted, while the export of agricultural products, including crops and processed foods, also plunged, reducing peasant incomes. Railway companies and other transportation industries also experienced a slump, which led to layoffs and wage cuts for workers. Peasants suffered under the burden of various taxes and exploitation by landlords, such as increased rents and high interest on loans. Warlords, the national bourgeoisie, and Japanese imperialism compounded the misery of the masses. The Northeast government, which was under the control of warlords, had a variety of methods for stealing land from cultivators, such as intentionally mismeasuring it and setting unrealistic requirements for documentating ownership. The Northeast government and the national bourgeoisie also collaborated with Japanese imperial powers in exploiting peasants, workers, and small merchants. Japanese merchants controlled about 60 percent of all retail stores. Japanese also operated the South Manchuria Railway, mines, and various factories, while continuing to amass agricultural lands.
With this assessment of Manchuria’s economic conditions, the mpc lumped capitalists, landlords, and bourgeoisie into the category of class enemies of the peasants and workers.

zh: 满洲省委对满洲的这一评估，与中共的阶级斗争政策汇聚，但在革命先锋的判断上存在分歧。对中共而言，北满工人——尤其是哈尔滨及其附近的工人——应是先锋，因为北满铁路、矿山与工厂雇佣的工人比其他任何地方都多。对满洲省委而言，正如其1930年4月会议报告所示，南满铁路及南满港口、矿山与兵工厂的工人，最有能力领导满洲革命。满洲省委的判断出自这样的观察：北满工人专注于经济斗争而非政治动员，南满工人则因南满是军阀与日本人的堡垒而遭受更多压迫。
en: This mpc evaluation of Manchuria converged with the ccp policy of class struggle but with differences on the prognosis of the vanguard of the revolution. For the ccp, workers in North Manchuria, especially those in and near Harbin, should be the vanguard, because North Manchuria employed more workers in railways, mines, and factories than anywhere else. For the mpc, as its April 1930 meeting report suggests, workers on the South Manchuria Railway and in the ports, mines, and artillery factories of South Manchuria had the greatest capacity to lead the revolution in Manchuria. The mpc diagnosis is derived from the observation that workers in North Manchuria concentrated on economic struggle rather than political mobilization, while those in South Manchuria experienced more oppression due to the fact that South Manchuria was the stronghold of warlords and the Japanese.

zh: 中共与满洲省委都避而未谈一个事实：东满的朝鲜人正领导着革命斗争。中共依照共产国际的一国一党原则，指示满洲的朝鲜共产主义者加入中共。虽然朝鲜共产主义者在加入中共之前领导着各种组织，中共却拒绝把他们作为一个可在党内持有代表权的群体来吸纳。满洲省委要求朝鲜共产主义者放弃解放朝鲜的斗争，转而投身中国革命。这清楚显示了满洲省委与中共所采取的中国民族主义的同质化力量。
en: Both the ccp and the mpc glossed over the fact that Koreans in East Manchuria were leading the revolutionary struggle. Organized by the Comintern principle of one party in one country, the ccp directed the Koreans of Manchuria to join the ccp. While Korean communists had led various organizations before joining the ccp, the ccp refused to enlist them as a group that could hold representative power within it. The mpc demanded that the Korean communists abandon their struggle to liberate Korea and instead commit to the Chinese revolution. This clearly demonstrates the homogenizing force of the Chinese nationalism adopted by the mpc and ccp.

zh: 满洲省委试图在中国民族主义之内处理朝鲜与中国农民的不平等社会关系。这一尝试寄托于一种特殊的比较框架：它只承认朝鲜农民和中国农民所受压迫有程度之差。与中国同类相比，朝鲜农民被视为遭受地主、军阀政府与日本帝国主义更多压迫。据说朝鲜人还受朝鲜人民会与朝鲜人保护会等亲日组织的剥削。满洲省委因此号召朝鲜人参加阶级斗争，从地主与亲日土地所有者手中夺取土地。没收的土地按各户劳动力数量（十五至五十岁男子与十五至四十岁女子各计一分）分配给游击队员家庭、佃农与农业劳工。解放区的苏维埃政府拥有没收的土地，禁止土地交易与其他市场买卖。
en: The mpc attempted to address the unequal social relations of Korean and Chinese peasants within Chinese nationalism. This attempt was lodged in a particular comparative framework that recognized distinctions between Korean and Chinese peasants only in terms of their quantitative differences. Compared to their Chinese counterparts, Korean peasants were seen to be suffering more oppression from landlords, the warlord government, and Japanese imperialism. Koreans were also said to be exploited by pro-Japanese organizations such as the Korean Association and the Association to Protect Koreans. The mpc thus called on Koreans to join the class struggle, which sought to seize land from the landlords and pro-Japanese landowners. Appropriated land was distributed to the families of guerrillas, tenants, and farm laborers based on the amount of labor power per household (men between fifteen and fifty years of age and women between fifteen and forty counted as one point). The soviet governments in liberated zones owned the confiscated land and outlawed land transactions and other market trading.

zh: 满洲省委认定的朝鲜人与中国人之间的其他质的差异，包括耕作类型、文化差异以及与东北政府的关系。据满洲省委的报告，朝鲜农民沿河聚居，因为稻作需要良好供水，中国农民则从事旱作。由于语言不同，朝鲜人与中国人缺乏共同的沟通手段。此外，朝鲜人与中国人的敌对并非仅由文化差异造成。东北政府长期指控朝鲜人充当日本蚕食的先锋。九一八事变后国民党对朝鲜人的攻击反映了这种情绪。日本的策略进一步加剧了朝鲜人与中国人的对抗。例如，1931年占领满洲期间，一些日军穿着朝鲜式服装。
当东北政府在满洲大部分地区禁止朝鲜人居住与拥有土地、以图阻止日本蚕食时，满洲省委承诺保护朝鲜人免受驱逐威胁。
en: Other qualitative differences between Koreans and Chinese identified by the mpc included types of farming, cultural differences, and relations with the Northeast government. According to the reports of the mpc, Korean peasants congregated along rivers because rice farming requires a good water supply, while Chinese peasants engaged in dry farming. Koreans and Chinese lacked a common means of communication due to their different languages. In addition, the hostility between Koreans and Chinese ran more deeply than cultural differences. The Northeast government had long accused Koreans of acting as the vanguard for Japanese encroachment. The Kuomingtang’s attack on Koreans in the aftermath of the Manchuria Incident reflected this sentiment. Japanese tactics further aggravated the antagonism between Koreans and Chinese. For instance, some Japanese forces wore Korean-style clothing during the occupation of Manchuria in 1931.

When the Northeast government in most parts of Manchuria banned Korean residence and landownership in its effort to stop Japanese encroachment, the mpc pledged to protect Koreans from the threat of eviction.

zh: 满洲省委关于族群关系的这一系列评估，未能理解满洲的历史特殊性。满洲省委预设朝鲜农民与中国同类共享先验的阶级身份，而实际上朝鲜农民和中国农民经由类似的社会政策，分别受到日本方面和东北政府的牵系。以改善朝鲜人社会生活为承诺，日本殖民者通过提供贷款与其他经济补贴动员朝鲜农民。同样，东北军阀政府与中国资产阶级向中国农民提供类似服务以获取支持。帝国主义者与东北军阀政府的这些做法，模糊了土地所有者与贫农的边界。旨在废除私有财产的阶级斗争，不太可能吸引贫农的支持。单靠阶级斗争无法切断农民与中国革命敌人之间的纽带。除非他们能提供贷款与其他社会供给的替代，中国共产主义者无法吸引朝鲜农民。
en: This series of mpc assessments on ethnic relations fell short of understanding the historical specificity of Manchuria. While the mpc presupposed a priori class identities that Korean peasants shared with Chinese counterparts, each Korean and Chinese peasant was, in reality, tied to the Japanese and the Northeast government, respectively, through similar social programs. With the promise of improving the social lives of Koreans, Japanese colonizers mobilized Korean peasants by offering loans and other economic subsidies. Similarly, the Northeast warlord government and the Chinese bourgeoisie provided similar services to Chinese peasants to obtain their support. These practices of the imperialists and the Northeast warlord government blurred the boundary between landowners and poor peasants. The class struggle, which aimed to abolish private property, was unlikely to attract the support of poor peasants. The class struggle alone would not break the peasants’ ties to the enemies of the Chinese revolution. Unless they could offer alternatives to loans and other social provisions, the Chinese communists could not appeal to Korean peasants.

zh: 满洲省委将朝鲜人界定为“少数族群”，并倡导其追求民族自决的权利。由于这一政策类似于列宁主义策略——支持俄罗斯帝国内各族群的自决以促其解体——满洲省委的这一政策也服务于使朝鲜人脱离日本人的类似目的。1932年2月，满洲省委下属的东满特委提出民族自决，作为包括民生团运动在内的朝鲜人长期追求的民族自治（汉语 minzu zizhi）的替代：“民生团怎能以承诺自卫、自治与独立来为人民保障自由与住房？用产业确保会（汉语 chanye quebaohui）这样的经济保障计划来拯救资本主义社会数百万失业者，是荒谬的。……与中国革命一道，中共的少数民族自决政策将为满洲全体朝鲜人提供自由与平等。”
en: The mpc constructed Koreans as a “minority” and advocated their right to pursue self-determination. As this policy was similar to the Leninist strategy that supported the self-determination of ethnic groups in the Russian empire so as to facilitate its disintegration, this mpc policy served the similar purpose of separating Koreans from the Japanese. In February 1932, the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee under the mpc presented self-determination as an alternative to the national self-rule (minzu zizhi in Chinese) long pursued by Koreans, including the Minsaengdan movement: “How could the Minsaengdan secure freedom and housing for people by promising self-defense, autonomy, and independence? It is absurd to rescue millions of the unemployed in capitalist society with an economic security program (chanye quebaohui in Chinese). . . . Together with the Chinese revolution, the ccp’s policy of self-determination of the minorities will provide freedom and equality to all Koreans in Manchuria.”

zh: 满洲省委把民族问题理解为政治问题，其促进民族自决的政策支持在朝鲜建立新的独立国家。一个问题在于：族群自决与对社会主义革命的支持之间并无内在联系——每个族群的自决并不能保证把不同族群与民族集团带向社会主义革命的阶级统一。卢森堡认识到俄国革命中族群民族主义与社会主义之间的类似鸿沟，发起对自决的批判，指出这种“空洞的小资产阶级式”民族主义诉求威胁着俄国革命的核心，因为革命的基本原则应是反对一切压迫，包括民族主义者实行的压迫。
en: Understanding the national question as a political question, the mpc policy of promoting self-determination supported the construction of a new independent state in Korea. A problem was that there was no intrinsic link between self-determination of ethnic groups and their support for socialist revolution: the self-determination of each ethnic group would not guarantee the class unity of different ethnic and national groups that could bring them to the socialist revolution. Recognizing a similar gulf between ethnic nationalism and socialism in the Russian revolution, Luxemburg unleashed a critique of self-determination, noting that this “nothing but hollow, petty bourgeoisie,” nationalistic demand threatened the very heart of the Russian revolution, since the basic principle of revolution would be the opposition of all oppression, including that practiced by nationalists.

zh: 中国共产主义者试图弥合这一鸿沟，办法是把朝鲜农民固定为阶级主体，其利益被认为与中国农民的利益相同。把朝鲜人建构为少数族群，对于朝鲜人与中国革命的关系，却有两重含义。虽然把朝鲜人归类为少数族群指涉他们在日本统治下的地位，它也开始指涉他们与中国民族国家的关系——后者由中国共产主义者代表。朝鲜民族自决的观念意味着朝鲜人建立自己民族国家的权利，而少数族群概念却把朝鲜人的政治纳入中国革命的进程。少数族群一词是一个基于领土的概念，它把中国人（大概是汉人）视为多数，使其他族群从属。在这一框架中，尽管文化不同，朝鲜人与中国人却被假定拥有支持中国革命的相同主体性。
en: Chinese communists tried to bridge this gulf by fixing Korean peasants as class subjects whose interests were thought to be identical to those of the Chinese peasants. The construction of Koreans as a minority harbored ambiguous meanings for the relationship of Koreans with the Chinese revolution. Although the categorization of Koreans as a minority referred to their status under Japanese rule, it also came to denote their relations with the Chinese nation-state, represented by Chinese communists. While the notion of Korean self-determination implies the right of Koreans to create their own nation-state, the concept of the minority assimilated Koreans’ politics into the making of the Chinese revolution. The term minority was a territorially based concept that considered the Chinese (presumably the Han Chinese) to be the majority and subordinated other ethnic groups. Despite their cultural differences, Koreans and Chinese in this framework were supposed to have an identical subjectivity in support of the Chinese revolution.

zh: 这些关于朝鲜人的政策，未能说明民族主义、资本主义与日本帝国主义交织的关系。在东北军阀政府与日本帝国主义两者的政治中，民族主义都组织了资本主义生产与市场交换关系，形成了朝鲜人与中国人之间不平等的关系。因此，东北军阀政府与日本帝国主义都把其权力嵌入社会关系。把民族主义假定为仅内在于民族国家体系，妨碍了中国共产主义者理解满洲的独特条件。1933年至1935年，当反帝斗争伴随反民生团斗争时，中国共产主义者关于朝鲜少数族群的民族主义政策进一步升级。
en: These policies about Koreans failed to account for the intertwined relationship of nationalism, capitalism, and Japanese imperialism. In both the politics of the Northeast warlord government and Japanese imperialism, nationalism had organized the capitalist relations of production and market exchange, producing the uneven relations of Koreans and Chinese. Both the Northeast warlord government and Japanese imperialism had therefore embedded their powers in social relations. The supposition of nationalism as intrinsic only to the nation-state system prevented the Chinese communists from comprehending the unique conditions in Manchuria. The nationalist Chinese communist policy on the Korean minority further escalated from 1933 to 1935, when its anti-imperialist struggle was accompanied by the anti-Minsaengdan struggle.

zh: 1933年至1935年的社会主义国际主义
en: Socialist Internationalism from 1933 to 1935

zh: 中共1933年1月把抗日确立为民族斗争的目标，被誉为终于承认满洲独特地方条件的重大举措。跨阶级联盟被视为扩大民族斗争群众基础的政治策略。民族斗争预示着土地改革与朝鲜人政策的变化。新土地改革承认私有财产制度。此前的阶级斗争政策要求没收一切地主的土地，新的抗日斗争政策则只没收亲日地主的土地。新政策允许土地交换与市场活动，聚焦于减租而非废除地主制度。
en: The ccp’s adoption of the anti-Japanese national struggle in January 1933 was hailed as a major move toward finally acknowledging the distinctive local conditions of Manchuria. The cross-class alliance was taken as a political strategy to expand the mass base of the national struggle. The national struggle heralded changes in land reform and the policy on Koreans. The new land reform acknowledged the private property system. While the previous policy of class struggle called for confiscation of land from all landlords, the new policy of anti-Japanese struggle aimed to seize land only from pro-Japanese landlords. The new policy allowed the exchange of land and market activities, focusing on the reduction of rent rather than abolition of the landlord system.

zh: 历史学家争论过这样一个问题：在中国革命中，激起农民支持共产主义者的，是土地改革还是反帝民族主义。马克·塞尔登认为两者都发挥了作用，查默斯·约翰逊则把民族主义认定为主要支持来源。
就满洲而言，Lee Chong Sik 观察到，温和的土地改革扩大了游击根据地。苏维埃在东满只吸纳4,500人，约相当于秋收与春荒起义（卷入两万多人）期间农民动员数的五分之一；而到1933年末，十三个人民政府已有三万多拥护者。
农民与共产主义者还修筑防御墙，在彼此之间及与其他村庄之间发展紧急通信网络，并制定逃生计划，如向山中挖地道。他们还开办武器制造设施和缝纫所，后者为游击队供应衣物。
en: Historians have debated the issue of whether land reform or anti-imperialist nationalism galvanized peasant support for communists in the Chinese revolution. Mark Selden accepts both, while Chalmers Johnson identifies nationalism as the main source of the support.

In the case of Manchuria, Lee Chong Sik observed that moderate land reform expanded the guerrilla bases. While the soviets enlisted only 4,500 persons in East Manchuria, about one fifth of the peasant mobilization during the Harvest and Spring uprisings, which had involved more than 20,000, the thirteen people’s governments had more than 30,000 adherents by the end of 1933.

Peasants and communists also built defense walls, developed emergency communication networks among themselves and in other villages, and drafted escape plans such as digging tunnels into the mountains. They also operated weapons-making facilities and sewing centers to supply clothing to the guerrillas.

zh: 新土地改革政策扩大了对共产主义活动的支持。但它缺陷太多，无法解决社会对抗。它未能使中国共产主义者说明东北政府与日本帝国主义如何借助民族主义政治、把它锚定于社会关系。与先前的土地改革政策一样，它把民族主义只绑定在民族国家体系之内，而不把它植根于社会领域。关于朝鲜少数族群的政策延续了这种对民族主义的政治与文化路径。1933年6月接到中共开始抗日斗争的命令后，满洲省委制定了一项决议，旨在把“少数民族”（汉语 shaoshu minzu）整合进反对日本帝国主义的统一战线：“我们必须整合满洲的少数民族，以便共同发起抗日斗争。……我们需要教导中国与朝鲜的劳动人民，反对日本、满洲国与国民党分裂中朝人民统一战线的策略。”
在同一决议中，满洲省委把组织扩张与使中国人成为中共多数的任务等同起来：“虽然中共不断扩大其影响，其组织仍然太小，无法执行政治任务。最重要的任务之一是扩大组织、不断加强征税，把它变成一个群众党。1933年8月1日以前，我们必须至少把党员数增加两倍，使中国人的代表比例不少于党员的三分之二，工人的代表比例至少五分之一。”

children: 〔校注〕引文中的 collection of taxes 按原文译作“征税”。

en: The new land reform policy broadened the support for communist activities. But it was too flawed to resolve social antagonism. It did not enable the Chinese communists to account for the ways in which the Northeast government and Japanese imperialism drew on nationalist politics, anchoring it in social relations. Like the previous land reform policy, it bound nationalism only within the nation-state system, without grounding it in the social sphere. The policies pertaining to the Korean minority prolonged this political and cultural approach to nationalism. After receiving the ccp’s order to commence the anti-Japanese struggle in June 1933, the mpc formulated a resolution aimed at integrating “minority nationalities” (shaoshu minzu in Chinese) into the united front against Japanese imperialism: “We must integrate minority nationalities in Manchuria so as to launch together the anti-Japanese struggle. . . . We need to instruct the working people of China and Korea to oppose the strategy of Japan, Manchukuo, and the Kuomintang, which has sought to divide the united front of the people of China and Korea.”

In the same resolution, the mpc equated its organizational expansion with the task of making Chinese the majority in the ccp: “Although the ccp has incessantly expanded its influence, its organization still remains too small to execute its political tasks. One of the most important tasks is to expand its organization, steadfastly increase the collection of taxes, and turn it into a mass party. Before August 1, 1933, we must at least triple the membership of the party to increase the representation of Chinese to no less than two-thirds of the membership and the representation of workers to at least one-fifth.”

zh: 满洲省委对组织霸权的渴望再造了社会关系。所有中国农民，无论其迁移的时间与久暂、出身与居住地，都被同质化为统一的民族主体。满洲的所有朝鲜农民则要被单一化，作为少数族群纳入。他们受压迫的经验及随后的革命目标，被认为与中国农民相同。这种对朝鲜与中国主体性的单一化，抹去了一个事实：朝鲜人与中国人的社会关系不仅由民族国家体系的动态组织，也由资本主义动态组织。日本帝国主义者、东北军阀政府、中国资产阶级与满洲国政权，在竞相占领满洲领土的过程中挑起冲突、进行谈判。他们同时合作又争夺该地区的资本主义发展。随着资本流动和贸易往来，资本主义动态把满洲市场绑定于日本帝国其他部分与世界经济。满洲省委把革命群众的民族身份视为既定不变，把农民的全球社会经验误认为想象的民族国家领土内的社会体经验。这种倾向体现在中共把群众组织建构为民族国家的领土与社会体单位的方式上。例子包括已婚妇女会、儿童团、青年团、农民协会与工会。满洲省委的民族实践掩盖了这样一个事实：虽然朝鲜与中国农民殊异的社会关系并不排除他们在社会主义革命斗争中的社会统一，这些关系却要求他们从事相关却分立的社会斗争。
en: The mpc’s aspiration for organizational hegemony reinvented social relations. All Chinese peasants, regardless of the time and duration of their migration, their origins, and their place of residence, were homogenized as unified national subjects. All Korean peasants in Manchuria were to be singularized and incorporated as a minority. Their experiences of oppression and subsequent revolutionary objectives were identical to those of Chinese peasants. This singularization of Korean and Chinese subjectivities elided the fact that the social relations of Koreans and Chinese were organized not just by the dynamics of the nation-state system but also by capitalist dynamics. Japanese imperialists, the Northeast warlord government, the Chinese bourgeoisie, and the Manchukuo state instigated conflicts and undertook negotiations in their competing pursuit of the territorial occupation of Manchuria. They simultaneously collaborated and contended for the capitalist development of the region. With the exchange of capital and trade, capitalist dynamics bound the Manchurian market to other parts of the Japanese empire and the world economy. Assuming the essentialist national identities of the revolutionary masses, the mpc misrecognized the global social experiences of peasants as societal experiences within the territory of an imagined nation-state. This tendency was manifest in the ways the ccp built its mass organizations as territorial and societal units of the nation-state. Examples include the Married Women’s Society, Children’s Corps, Youth Corps, peasant associations, and workers’ unions. The national practices of the mpc obscured the fact that, although they did not preclude their social unity in the struggle for socialist revolution, the disparate social relations of Korean and Chinese peasants required that they engage in related yet discrete social struggles.

zh: 朝鲜共产主义者的民族主义
en: korean communist nationalism

zh: 朝鲜共产主义者在满洲开展革命斗争时，也遇到了与中国共产主义者一样的问题，即从民族主义出发抽象地看待社会。他们在民族国家框架内运作，在追求朝鲜独立与参加中国革命之间摇摆。朝鲜共产主义者因此与中国同类共享一种民族主义视角，把满洲同化进他们所倡导的民族国家。朝鲜共产主义者总体上在两种斗争之间摇摆——解放朝鲜与进行中国革命——他们视这两种斗争为不相容。他们对朝鲜人自治的短暂倡导，只是其力图面对满洲独特条件的一个时刻。我考察朝鲜共产主义者在民族国家框架内修改其满洲概念的三个实例：1923年至1928年在满洲重建朝鲜共产党（kcp）的斗争；1929年至1930年与朝鲜非共产主义民族主义者的统一战线；以及1930年朝鲜共产党成员并入中共。这些时期对满洲的概念化，体现了他们对朝鲜农民状况的社会意识。每个时刻都以朝鲜共产主义者独特的组织重组为标志。
en: The approach of Korean communists to revolutionary struggle in Manchuria is fraught with the same symptoms that afflicted Chinese communists —the nationalist abstraction of the social. They operated within the nation-state framework, in which they vacillated between pursuit of Korean independence and participation in the Chinese revolution. Korean communists thus shared with their Chinese counterparts a nationalist perspective that assimilated Manchuria into the nation-state they advocated. Korean communists in general oscillated between two struggles—to liberate Korea and to make the Chinese revolution—struggles they viewed as incompatible. Their brief advocacy of Korean self-rule was only a moment in their attempt to confront the unique conditions in Manchuria. I examine three instances of Korean communist activity when Korean communists modified their conceptualization of Manchuria within the nation-state framework: the struggle to re-create the Korean Communist Party (kcp) in Manchuria from 1923 to 1928, the united front with Korean noncommunist nationalists from 1929 to 1930, and the party’s entry into the Chinese Communist Party in 1930. The conceptualizations of Manchuria in these periods embodied their social consciousness of Korean peasant conditions. Each moment was marked by a distinctive organizational reconfiguration of the Korean communists.

zh: 朝鲜与满洲
en: Korea and Manchuria

zh: 朝鲜共产主义活动始于1920年代初。1923年，朝鲜共产主义青年组织在满洲各地成立。朝鲜共产党1925年5月在汉城成立后，其满洲总局（Manju Ch'ongguk，下文简称“总局”）于1926年5月建立。间岛是总局活动的中心，它专注于组织农民与青年。1927年10月总局领导一场大规模示威后，日本领事警察对朝鲜共产主义者的逮捕使总局陷入混乱。1927年以前一直领导总局的火曜派（Tuesday group），于1928年2月以其自身成员重建总局。
在一场权力斗争中，与之竞争的马克思列宁主义派（ml派）与汉城—上海派同年也建立了总局。
en: Korean communist activities dated from the early 1920s. Korean communist youth organizations were formed across Manchuria in 1923. After the Korean Communist Party was founded in Seoul in May 1925, its Manchurian General Bureau (Manju Ch’ongguk, hereafter referred to as “the bureau”) was established in May 1926. Kando was the center of the activities of the bureau, which concentrated on organizing peasants and youth. Following a large-scale demonstration led by the bureau in October 1927, the arrests of Korean communists by Japanese consular police left the bureau in disarray. The Tuesday group of Korean communists, which had directed the bureau until 1927, reconstructed it with its own members in February 1928.
In a power struggle, the rival Marxist-Leninist (ml) group and Seoul-Shanghai group established bureaus in the same year.

zh: 直到1930年加入中共之前，各派朝鲜共产主义者共享朝鲜独立与在满洲、朝鲜进行阶级斗争的目标。他们把朝鲜农民呈现为民族主体与阶级主体，两者都预设其先验利益。作为民族主体，朝鲜农民被认为在把朝鲜从日本统治下解放出来方面切身利益都与此相关。作为阶级主体，他们被假定与中国农民共享相同利益。火曜派的总局誓言废除日本帝国主义，同时进行阶级斗争，反对国民党与军阀，没收地主的一切土地。火曜派组成的农民联合会旨在把朝鲜从日本统治下解放出来，并使土地国有化。ml派的总局也宣布阶级战争，同时号召与民族资产阶级建立反对封建压迫的统一战线。
他们的主要活动包括组织抗议（如1928年五一节的劳工抗议），以及发起对日本领事馆与其他设施的袭击。
en: Until they joined the ccp in 1930, various Korean communists shared the goal of Korean independence and class struggle in Manchuria and Korea. They represented Korean peasants as national and class subjects, both of which presupposed their a priori interests. As national subjects, Korean peasants were said to have a vested interest in liberating Korea from Japanese rule. As class subjects, they presumedly shared identical interests with Chinese peasants. The Tuesday group’s bureau vowed to abolish Japanese imperialism while engaging in class struggle to fight the Kuomintang and warlords and confiscate all land owned by landlords. Peasant federations formed by the Tuesday group aimed to liberate Korea from Japanese rule and nationalize the land. The ml group’s bureau also declared class warfare while calling for a united front with the national bourgeoisie against feudal oppression.
Their main activities included organizing protests, such as the labor protests that took place on May Day in 1928, and staging attacks on Japanese consulates and other facilities.

zh: 这种呈现并未触及朝鲜人的特殊经验与关切——它们来自军阀政治与日本帝国主义，后者以不同于中国农民的方式组织朝鲜农民的土地所有、佃租与就业。当朝鲜共产主义者聚焦满洲条件时，他们并未关注生产与交换的社会关系。相反，他们聚焦于日本帝国主义与中国官员的腐败。例如，1927年总局反对日本修筑铁路——一场著名的抗日行动。为预防日韩商人联合行动捍卫其对外贸易垄断，总局还抗议东北政府提高关税税率。此外，总局呼吁东北政府的民主改造，提议终结乡约（Hyangyak）这一村级行政单位的滥权。由于乡约监督户籍登记与税收征收，它歧视朝鲜人，向朝鲜人而非中国人摊派更高、更特殊的税赋，并强迫朝鲜人入籍。
ml派1928年建立、后来成为满洲最大组织的在华朝鲜人青年同盟（Chaechungguk Hanin ch'ŏngnyŏn tongmaeng），也敦促满洲朝鲜人清除腐败的中国官员、终结对朝鲜人的歧视。
en: This representation did not bear on Koreans’ specific experiences and concerns, which resulted from the warlord politics and Japanese imperialism that organized landownership, tenancy, and employment of Korean peasants in ways different from their Chinese counterparts. When Korean communists focused on conditions in Manchuria, they did not attend to the social relations of production and exchange. Instead, they focused on Japanese imperialism and the corruption of Chinese officials. For instance, in 1927 the bureau opposed the construction of railways by Japan, a well-known anti-Japanese action. In order to preempt the allied actions of Japanese and Korean merchants to defend their monopoly on foreign trade, the bureau also protested against the Northeast government’s increase in tariff rates. In addition, the bureau called for a democratic transformation of the Northeast government, proposing to end the abusive power of the Hyangyak, the village administrative unit. Since it oversaw the registration of households and the collection of taxes, the Hyangyak discriminated against Koreans, assigning higher and special kinds of taxes and dues to Koreans, but not to Chinese, and forcing Koreans to become naturalized.

The Youth Federation of Koreans in China (Chaechungguk Hanin ch’ŏngnyŏn tongmaeng), which was established by the ml group in 1928 and became the largest organization in Manchuria, also urged Koreans in Manchuria to remove corrupt Chinese officials and end discrimination against Koreans.

zh: 正是与朝鲜民族主义者的统一战线，使朝鲜共产主义者注意到满洲朝鲜人的特殊社会条件。受中国国共合作统一战线、以及朝鲜共产主义者与民族资产阶级联盟的鼓舞，满洲朝鲜共产主义者1928年与其他民族主义者联合创建民族唯一党（Minjok yuiltang）。统一战线中关键的非共产主义民族主义团体包括参议府（Ch'amŭibu）、正义府（Chungŭibu）与新民府（Sinminbu），它们于1920年代中期在南满、北满成立。统一战线形成之前，它们专注于发起对亲日朝鲜人与日本设施的袭击。这些非共产主义民族主义团体自诩为朝鲜人的自治政府，也承诺稳定朝鲜农民生活、运营集体农场、提供教育。然而，由于它们向朝鲜居民强制收取会费与其他财政捐献，共产主义者谴责它们剥削本已受压迫、陷于贫困的朝鲜人。
en: It was the united front with Korean nationalists that brought the attention of Korean communists to the specific social conditions of Koreans in Manchuria. Encouraged by the united front of the ccp and the gmd in China and the coalition of communists and the national bourgeoisie in Korea, Korean communists in Manchuria joined other nationalists to create a unified national party (Minjok yuiltang) in 1928. Key noncommunist nationalist groups in the united front included the Ch’amŭibu, Chungŭibu, and Sinminbu, which were formed in the mid-1920s in South and North Manchuria. Before the formation of the united front, they had concentrated on launching attacks on pro-Japanese Koreans and Japanese facilities. Representing themselves as Koreans’ self-government, the noncommunist nationalist groups also promised to stabilize the lives of Korean peasants, operate collective farms, and provide education. As they collected compulsory membership fees and other financial contributions from Korean residents, however, the communists had condemned them for exploiting Koreans, who already were oppressed and impoverished.

zh: 1928年，朝鲜共产主义者开始与非共产主义民族主义者合作，创建朝鲜人统一战线的两个联盟团体：协议会（Hyŏbŭihoe）与促成会（Ch'oksŏnghoe）。由于各方仍在结盟形式上存在意识形态分歧，朝鲜人统一战线经历了一系列激烈的组织重组——一种称为派系主义的现象。协议会由正义府与两个共产主义团体——火曜派与汉城—上海派——组成；促成会则由参议府与ml派领导的青年组织组成。协议会1929年4月创建国民府（Kungminbu），后者很快分裂为民政和军事两部。民政部保留原名，专注于满洲朝鲜人的自治；军事部改组为朝鲜革命党（Chosŏn Hyŏngmyŏngdang）。促成会1928年12月改名革新议会（Hyŏksin ŭihoe），一年后组建策进会（Ch'aekchinhoe）。随着新民府1928年解散，革新议会吸纳其军事团体，国民府吸纳其民政方面的组织。新民府的一些成员与无政府主义者合作，1929年7月组织韩族总联合会（Hanjok ch'ong yŏnhaphoe）。
en: In 1928, Korean communists began to cooperate with noncommunist nationalists to create two coalition groups of the Korean united front: the Hyŏbŭihoe and Ch’oksŏnghoe. Still torn by ideological conflicts over the format of the coalitions, the Korean united front underwent a series of intense organizational restructurings—a phenomenon called factionalism. The Hyŏbŭihoe was comprised of the Chŏngŭibu and two communist groups—the Tuesday group and the Seoul-Shanghai group—while the Ch’oksŏnghoe was comprised of the Ch’amŭibu and youth organizations led by the ml group. The Hyŏbŭihoe created the League of Koreans (Kungminbu) in April 1929, which soon split into civil and military departments. The civil department retained the name to focus on self-rule in Manchuria, and the military department was reorganized into the Korean Revolutionary Party (Chosŏn Hyŏngmyŏngdang). Ch’oksŏnghoe was renamed the Revolutionary Assembly (Hyŏksin ŭihoe) in December 1928 and formed the Ch’aekchinhoe one year later. With the dissolution of the Sinminbu in 1928, the Revolutionary Assembly incorporated its military group, while the League of Koreans absorbed the civil group. Some members of the Sinminbu collaborated with anarchists to organize the Korean Federation (Hanjok ch’ong yŏnhaphoe) in July 1929.

zh: 由于朝鲜非共产主义民族主义者——尤其是正义府——曾诉诸朝鲜人自治，满洲统一战线把朝鲜人自治采纳为其重要宣言之一。协议会与促成会都支持朝鲜人入籍。在自治口号下，国民府在朝鲜人居住区选举代表。为给朝鲜人争取耕作权，它承诺与中国官员谈判一系列措施，包括限制地主垄断、保障朝鲜人耕作的特定期限、减租、协助灌溉设施。革新议会也誓言建立自治行政机构。
国民府经营数家磨坊与店铺，以缓解朝鲜农民的处境——他们此前依赖中国地主与商人拥有的磨坊，后者收取高额费用，并在城市经营店铺。
韩族总联合会也把解放朝鲜与在满洲建立朝鲜人自治的目标结合起来。在训练游击队的同时，它以村落自治单位为基础组建组织。它为满洲朝鲜人采取的社会措施，与满洲国政权及朝鲜总督府1933年采取的措施相似。韩族总联合会把自己定义为独立、自治、合作的组织，承诺阻止朝鲜人脱离土地、建立集体农场、运营农民合作社联合会、组织新耕作方法及农业技术的培训，并实行日用品集体购买与农作物集体销售。
en: As Korean noncommunist nationalists, especially the Chŏngŭibu, had invoked Korean self-rule, the united front in Manchuria adopted Korean self-rule as one of its important declarations. Both the Hyŏbŭihoe and Ch’oksŏnghoe supported the naturalization of Koreans. Under the slogan of self-rule, the League of Koreans elected representatives in Korean residential areas. In order to obtain the right to cultivation for Koreans, it pledged to negotiate with Chinese officials on a number of measures, including restricting the monopoly of landlords, guaranteeing a specific time period for Korean cultivation, reducing rent, and assisting with irrigation facilities. The Revolutionary Assembly also vowed to create a self-rule administration.

The League of Koreans ran several mills and stores to alleviate the condition of the Korean peasants, as they had depended on mills owned by Chinese landlords and merchants, who charged high fees and operated stores in the cities.

The Korean Federation also combined the goals of liberating Korea and establishing Korean self-rule in Manchuria. While training guerrilla armies, it formed its organizations on the basis of self-rule units in the villages. Its social measures for Koreans in Manchuria were similar to those adopted by the Manchukuo state and the Government General of Korea in 1933. Defining itself as an independent, self-governing, cooperative organization, the Korean Federation pledged to thwart Korean displacement from land, establish collective farms, operate farmers’ cooperative unions, oversee instruction about new agricultural methods and innovations, and institute the collective purchase of daily essentials and collective sale of crops.

zh: 统一战线旨在扩大抗日斗争。在这一框架下，对自治的支持与共产主义者继续开展的阶级斗争并行。在民族唯一党形成期间，关键的朝鲜人组织尽管存在分歧，仍就自治达成共识。协议会预见朝鲜人自治组织将成为中国行政单位的一部分。ml派力图在已加入中国国籍的朝鲜人的领导下与中国人合作建立朝鲜人自治。国民府则偏好朝鲜人自治运动拥有更多自主，反对朝鲜人自治组织臣服于中国行政的想法。
在华朝鲜人青年同盟宣布其首要目标为朝鲜人自治、取得中国国民资格、追求土地买卖权。
朝鲜人自治问题意味着对朝鲜农民状况的社会意识。虽然他们对自治的倡导并未完全涵盖朝鲜人与中国人之间复杂的社会关系，至少它显示了处理朝鲜人被剥夺土地所有权与居留权之处境的尝试。统一战线对自治的促进，表明对其早先把满洲视为“朝鲜的延伸”（Chosŏn yŏnjang chuŭi，朝鲜延长主义）的民族国家路径的修正。它帮助他们认识到，满洲朝鲜人的处境不能单靠争取朝鲜独立的民族斗争或阶级斗争来处理。
en: As much as the united front was a political strategy to expand the anti-Japanese struggle, sponsorship of self-rule came to coexist with the class struggle pursued by the communists, who joined the united front. During the formation of the unified national party, key Korean organizations reached a consensus on self-rule, despite some differences. The Hyŏbuihoe foresaw the Korean self-rule organization as being part of the Chinese administrative unit. The ml group sought to create Korean self-rule in cooperation with the Chinese under the leadership of naturalized Koreans. The League of Koreans favored more autonomy for the Korean self-rule movement, objecting to the idea that the Korean self-rule organization would submit to the Chinese administration.
The Youth Federation of Koreans in China announced as its primary objectives Korean self-rule, acquisition of Chinese national membership, and pursuit of the right to buy and sell land.

The issue of Korean self-rule signified the social consciousness about Korean peasants’ conditions. Even though their advocacy of self-rule did not fully encompass the complex social relations between Koreans and Chinese, at least it demonstrated the attempt to address the conditions under which Koreans were deprived of landownership and residency. The promotion of self-rule by the united front indicates a revision in its earlier nation-state approach, which regarded Manchuria “as an extension of Korea” (Chosŏn yŏnjang chuŭi). It helped them to recognize that Korean conditions in Manchuria could not be addressed solely by a national struggle for Korean independence or by class struggle.

zh: 但自治运动与阶级斗争的结合存在紧张。当时共产主义者的阶级斗争谴责私有财产制度，满洲的朝鲜人自治运动却渴望为朝鲜人争取耕作与拥有土地的权利。朝鲜共产主义者对于朝鲜人加入中国国籍一事也有争议。东北军阀政府将入籍定为取得土地所有权和安稳居留的条件。马克思列宁主义派青年组织接受入籍，朝鲜共产主义青年会却反对，理由是入籍费会给与国民党结盟的军阀政府增加收入。朝鲜共产主义者的目标与自治目标之间的脱节，显示了其地方社会意识的一个关键局限。
en: But there was tension in the marriage of the self-rule movement and the class struggle. While the class struggle of the communists at that time condemned the private property system, the Korean self-rule movement in Manchuria aspired to attain the right for Koreans to cultivate and own land. Korean communists also disputed the naturalization of Koreans as Chinese nationals, which the Northeast warlord government enforced as a prerequisite for landownership and secure residency. While the ml group’s youth organizations accepted the naturalization of Koreans, the Korean Communist Youth Association opposed it on the grounds that the naturalization fees would increase the revenue of the warlord government, which was allied with the Kuomintang. The disjuncture between the objectives of the Korean communists and the goal of self-rule suggests a crucial limit to their local social consciousness.

zh: 朝鲜共产主义者对满洲地方条件的关注是短暂的。他们很快采取了一种不同的民族国家视角，把满洲纳入建立新的中国国家这一目标。如果说统一战线修改了朝鲜共产主义者的领土民族主义，加入中共则再次重构了它。1930年3月，ml派宣布加入中国共产党，火曜派几个月后跟进。朝鲜共产主义者如今否定自己过去为朝鲜解放和满洲朝鲜人自治所作的努力。相反，他们誓言进行中国革命。
en: The Korean communists’ attention to local conditions in Manchuria was momentary. They soon adopted a different nation-state perspective, one that subsumed Manchuria into the goal of establishing a new Chinese state. If the united front modified the territorial nationalism of Korean communists, joining the ccp again reconfigured it. In March 1930, the ml group announced its entrance into the Chinese Communist Party, which was followed by the Tuesday group a few months later. Korean communists now denounced their earlier commitment to the liberation of Korea and Korean self-rule in Manchuria. Instead, they pledged to make the Chinese revolution.

zh: ml派呼吁其他朝鲜共产主义者放弃解放朝鲜的斗争，并为追求朝鲜民族主义、与中共及其中国革命竞争而作自我批评。ml派还把朝鲜群众纳入中国革命，设定朝鲜群众是阶级主体，其利益与中国群众的利益相同。这一剧变向朝鲜共产主义者展示了一种新的民族国家视角，它把朝鲜与中国的革命设定为不可调和地对抗。ml派1930年3月解散其组织的宣言概括了这一视角：
en: Appealing to other Korean communists to abandon their struggle to liberate Korea, the ml group offered a self-critique for pursuing Korean nationalism, competing against the ccp and its Chinese revolution. The ml group also united the Korean masses with the Chinese revolution, postulating that the Korean masses were class subjects whose interests were identical to those of the Chinese masses. This drastic change showed Korean communists a new nation-state perspective that posited the revolutions in Korea and China as irreconcilably antagonistic. The declaration in which the ml group dissolved its organization in March 1930 encapsulates this perspective:

zh: 朝鲜共产主义者把朝鲜共产党的组织扩展到满洲，从而维持与中共竞争的民族组织。……他们［朝鲜工农］遭受压迫和剥削的苦难，并非来自他们作为朝鲜人的处境，而是来自他们作为工人与农民的处境。此外，他们的悲惨处境不限于朝鲜农民，而是与中国工农共享。在这些条件下，如今显而易见：解放朝鲜的斗争不会把满洲朝鲜人从资本主义与封建的压迫剥削中解放出来。……满洲的朝鲜工农必须与中国工农联合起来[进行中国革命]。……因此，满洲朝鲜共产主义者的各派必须放弃把满洲视为朝鲜延伸的观念。
en: Korean communists have extended the organization of the Korean Communist Party to Manchuria, thereby sustaining national organizations rivaling the ccp. . . . Their [the Korean workers and peasants] calamitous experiences of oppression and exploitation did not arise from their condition as Koreans but from their condition as workers and peasants. Furthermore, their wretched conditions are not confined to Korean peasants but shared by Chinese workers and peasants. Under these conditions, it is now apparent that the struggle to liberate Korea will not bring about the liberation of the Koreans of Manchuria from capitalist and feudal oppression and exploitation. . . . Korean workers and peasants in Manchuria must unite with their Chinese counterparts [to make the Chinese revolution]. . . . Various factions of the Korean communists in Manchuria must therefore abandon their idea of Manchuria as an extension of Korea.

zh: 朝鲜共产主义者的民族主义及其统一战线，遮蔽了他们在1930年代与中国共产主义者的合作。当中国共产主义者指责朝鲜同志追求民族主义与派系主义时，他们援引1920年代朝鲜共产主义团体的不断重组。1930年以前，正如派系主义一词所示，朝鲜共产主义者因争夺权力和随之而来的反复改组而受谴责。既有朝鲜共产主义文献的一个主要焦点，是其众多组织的谱系，尤其是共产主义者之间的权力斗争及其与非共产主义民族主义者的冲突。然而，这种派系主义不能完全归因于权力斗争；它因参与力图处理满洲社会条件的统一战线而加剧。如前所述，例如统一战线的协议会联盟分裂为两个独立组织，追求被视为不相容的目标——实现满洲朝鲜人自治和实现朝鲜独立的运动。就统一战线为朝鲜共产主义者提供了关注满洲历史特殊条件的机会（尽管短暂）而言，协议会关于满洲与朝鲜关系的这一视角，使朝鲜共产主义者接触到满洲朝鲜人的独特社会条件。
en: The Korean communists’ nationalism and their united front overshadowed their cooperation with Chinese communists in the 1930s. When the Chinese communists accused their Korean comrades of pursuing nationalism and factionalism, they cited the constant reorganization of Korean communist groups during the 1920s. Prior to 1930, as the word factionalism suggests, Korean communists were denounced for their power struggles accompanied by capricious organizational restructuring. A primary focus of the existing literature on Korean communism is the genealogy of its numerous organizations, especially the power struggles among communists and their conflicts with noncommunist nationalists. Yet this factionalism was not completely attributable to power struggles; it was exacerbated by participation in the united front, which strove to tackle the social conditions of Manchuria. As mentioned earlier, the Hyŏbŭihoe coalition of the united front, for instance, broke into two separate organizations and pursued goals perceived to be incompatible—movements to realize Korean self-reliance and independence. As far as the united front supplied Korean communists with an opportunity, though fleeting, to attend to the historically specific conditions of Manchuria, this perspective of the Hyŏbŭihoe on the relationship between Manchuria and Korea exposed Korean communists to the unique social conditions of Koreans in Manchuria.

zh: 社会统一的建构
en: the construction of social unity

zh: 中国与朝鲜的民族主义规定了抗日民族斗争，可这套斗争路线越来越难以挑战殖民制度，也越来越难以指明怎样通过斗争重组社会关系。在满洲，朝鲜与中国农民之间碎片化与对抗的倾向，铭刻于满洲国建立前后殖民与民族政治所组织的社会关系本身。在满洲省委的政治中，朝鲜与中国农民的社会统一是由其同化政治工程强加的，并未化解社会关系中的冲突。清洗中民生团的幽灵，实际上是间岛无法被政治工程完全驯化的社会对抗。民生团成员构成新构想的社会整体的外部敌人；对他们的清洗是社会统一的“终极保障”。清洗朝鲜人的运动并不只是以新敌人——民生团成员——替换他们反对地主、资产阶级与日本人的阶级斗争和民族斗争。它反而让人们把朝鲜农民与中共的团结以及朝鲜与中国农民的团结视为理所当然。清洗是制定社会体统一的过程。换言之，反民生团斗争是试图通过把朝鲜革命者建构为“他者”、“反革命”（朝鲜语 panhyŏngmyŏng，汉语 fangeming）的社会要素，在社会领域实现统一。把朝鲜革命者描述为派系分子与民族主义者，精准点出了中国民族主义形成中的一个本质特征：中共通过把自己呈现为普遍革命的捍卫者（摆脱任何族群或民族特性）、把朝鲜共产主义者塑造为革命斗争的他者，来掩盖自己的民族主义。清洗把消灭朝鲜人变成消灭反革命分子。单是清洗的过度，就表明了中共如何在强力追求民族目标的同时，试图否认自己的民族主义与自我清洗行为。这种净化行为，是中共用来把社会关系建构为同质实体、排除朝鲜人与中国人以不平等方式被整合及其财产等级关系的现实的社会过程。
en: Chinese and Korean nationalisms prescribed the anti-Japanese national struggle, which became an increasingly irrelevant tool for challenging the colonial establishment and envisaging sensible struggles to organize social relations. In Manchuria, the tendency toward fragmentation and antagonism between Korean and Chinese peasants was inscribed in the very social relations organized by colonial and national politics before and after the founding of the Manchukuo state. In the mpc’s politics, the social unity of Korean and Chinese peasants was imposed by its political project of assimilation rather than by the resolution of social relations. The specter of the Minsaengdan in the purge was, in fact, social antagonism in Kando that could not be completely domesticated by the political project. Minsaengdan members constituted an external enemy of a newly envisaged social whole; their purge was “the ultimate guarantee” of the social unity. The drive to purge Koreans did not simply replace their class and national struggle against landlords, the bourgeoisie, and Japanese with a new enemy—Minsaengdan members.
