Rather it naturalized the unity of Korean peasants and the ccp, as well as the unity of Korean and Chinese peasants. The purge was the process of formulating the unity of the society. In other words, the anti-Minsaengdan struggle was an attempt to realize unity in the social realm by constructing Korean revolutionaries as “others,” social elements of the “counterrevolution” (panhyŏngmyŏng in Korean, fangeming in Chinese). Describing Korean revolutionaries as factionalists and nationalists pinpoints an essential feature in the formation of Chinese nationalism: the ccp obscured its own nationalism by representing itself as the defender of universal revolution (ridding itself of any ethnic or national character) and casting Korean communists as the other of the revolutionary struggle. The purge turned the elimination of Koreans into the elimination of counterrevolutionary elements. The excesses of the purge alone signify the ways in which the ccp attempted to deny its own nationalism and act of self-cleansing while forcefully pursuing national goals. This act of sterilization was the social process used by the ccp to construct social relations as a homogeneous entity, displacing the uneven integration of Koreans and Chinese and their hierarchical property relations.

zh: 清洗是中国共产主义者的民族主义工程与理想社会主义国际主义之间矛盾的创伤性表现。对所谓无处不在的敌人施加无节制的暴力，表明这类矛盾无法靠转嫁来消除。甚至对规范的细微偏离，例如革命力量中妇女的短发，都被视为民生团影响的迹象——它将疏离潜在支持者、削弱革命力量。
从枪支走火、报告拼写错误，到运粮或做饭中的疏忽，各种无心之失都被当作反革命行为与支持民生团的迹象。甚至稍稍流露出对党的批评，例如对寒冬将至、山中难民困苦无家的忧惧表达，都被怀疑为民生团行为。
这一系列离奇指控表明：当中共拒绝承认自己的民族主义时，其民族主义只能体现在对敌人的幻影建构之中。清洗的过度恐怖与暴力，悖论性地表明了社会空间同质化的不可能。正因如此，尽管民族主义盛行于满洲全境的中共，清洗却只发生在间岛——那里革命斗争确实在朝鲜人参与下推进。
en: The purge was a traumatic manifestation of the contradiction between the Chinese communists’ nationalist project and an ideal socialist internationalism. The unbridled cruelty against their ever-present enemies points to the impossibility of displacing such contradictions. Even slender deviations from norms, such as the short haircuts of women in the revolutionary forces, were regarded as signs of a Minsaengdan influence that would alienate would-be supporters and weaken the revolutionary forces.

Inadvertent accidents, ranging from the accidental firing of a gun and spelling errors in reports to an oversight in transporting grain or cooking a meal, were treated as acts of counterrevolution and signs of support for the Minsaengdan. Even the slightest suggestion of criticism of the party, such as expressing apprehension concerning the hardships and homelessness of refugees living in the mountains with winter approaching, was suspected as a Minsaengdan behavior.

This series of bizarre allegations suggests that when the ccp refused to recognize its nationalism, its nationalism came to be embodied only in the phantom construction of its enemy. The excessive terror and violence of the purge paradoxically denotes the impossibility of homogenizing the social space. It is for this reason that, despite the prevalence of nationalism in the ccp across Manchuria, the purge took place only in Kando, where the revolutionary struggle actually progressed with Korean participation.

zh: 反民生团斗争期间，中共把其敌人描述为有三个头：民族主义、派系主义与民生团。真正的敌人是朝鲜人自治，因为这三个头指向的都是朝鲜人自治。
中共把朝鲜共产主义者认定为“派系分子”，把他们定义为“戴着共产主义者面具的民族主义者”。1933年12月，东满特委向朝鲜群众呼吁，斥责朝鲜共产主义派系分子支持朝鲜人自治。
1933年末，满洲省委的一位代表宣称，一半以上的民生团成员是渗透进中共组织的“派系组织”头目，民生团代表反革命。
在1933年5月号的官方公报《两条战线》（汉语 Liangtiao zhangxian）中，东满特委详细阐述了对民生团的立场。民生团由朝鲜人地主、富农、高利贷者与商人资本家组成，他们在满洲国政权与日本的支持下抵抗革命；它还把各种朝鲜民族主义者、派系分子与宗教团体招入领导位置。据东满特委所言，民生团威胁间岛的共产主义暴动，以自治观念迷惑朝鲜群众，包括劳工、中农与贫农。
en: During the anti-Minsaengdan struggle, the ccp described its enemy as having three heads: nationalism, factionalism, and Minsaengdan. The real enemy was Korean self-rule, since it was a common denominator of the three heads.

The ccp identified Korean communists as “factionalists,” defining them as “nationalists masked as communists.” Appealing to the Korean masses in December 1933, the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee reproached Korean communist factionalists for supporting Korean self-rule.

In late 1933, a representative of the mpc declared that more than half the Minsaengdan members were the leaders of “factionalist organizations” who had penetrated ccp organizations and that the Minsaengdan stood for counterrevolution.

In the May 1933 edition of its official bulletin, Liangtiao zhangxian (in Chinese), the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee disclosed its extensive position on the Minsaengdan. It was comprised of Korean landlords, rich peasants, usurers, and merchant capitalists, who under the auspices of the Manchukuo state and Japan were resisting the revolution; it also recruited various Korean nationalists, factionalists, and religious groups to its leadership positions. According to the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee, the Minsaengdan threatened the communist insurgency in Kando, confounding the Korean masses of laborers, middle-level peasants, and poor peasants with the idea of self-rule.

zh: 朝鲜革命者在斗争中无力自保。此外，朝鲜人又近乎自发地参与了针对自身群体的指控，推动了清洗。朝鲜革命者既是错误指控的受害者，又是指控的参与者。这双重创伤部分源于他们错认了满洲朝鲜人的社会处境。朝鲜共产主义者无力捍卫其朝鲜人自治立场，部分源于他们自己的民族主义——它把民族与领土国家混为一谈。与中国同类一样，朝鲜共产主义者的领土化民族主义，应为其对满洲朝鲜人社会条件认识不足而受责备。由于中国与朝鲜共产主义者分别预设中国与朝鲜革命农民同质的民族主体性，朝鲜人自治问题便象征了革命主体令人不快的不统一。一方面，当他们把朝鲜人的独特性仅仅归于族群风俗时，朝鲜人自治开始指涉朝鲜人与中国人之间的本体论差异——它将扰乱中国革命的领土统一。另一方面，朝鲜共产主义者对满洲朝鲜人问题采取了类似的民族主义路径。把解放朝鲜的斗争与满洲的阶级斗争结合起来，朝鲜共产主义者假定朝鲜与满洲两地朝鲜人在民族与阶级主体性上的齐一。虽然朝鲜共产主义者与朝鲜民族主义者的统一战线提供了悬置那种使满洲从属于朝鲜的民族主义的重要机会，朝鲜共产主义者却把满洲的社会问题与朝鲜的民族问题结合起来，而不探讨两者的关系。中国与朝鲜共产主义者都试图把朝鲜人的独特关切化约为同质的革命任务。朝鲜人自治问题代表了朝鲜人与所谓统一主体之间他们无法接受的分裂。
en: Korean revolutionaries were defenseless during the struggle. Moreover, the struggle progressed with the quasi-spontaneous participation of Koreans in the very act that condemned them. This double trauma of Korean revolutionaries as victims and appellants in erroneous allegations in part harbored its own misrecognition of the social conditions of Koreans in Manchuria. The inability of Korean communists to defend their stance on Korean self-rule in part stemmed from their own nationalism, which conflated the nation with the territorial state. Like their Chinese counterparts, the territorializing nationalism of Korean communists was to be blamed for their inadequate recognition of the social conditions of Koreans in Manchuria. As the Chinese and Korean communists presumed a homogeneous national subjectivity of Chinese and Korean revolutionary peasants, respectively, the issue of Korean self-rule symbolized the undesirable disunity of revolutionary subjects. On the one hand, as they ascribed Korean distinctiveness merely to ethnic customs, Korean self-rule came to denote the ontological difference between Koreans and Chinese that would disturb the territorial unity of the Chinese revolution. On the other hand, Korean communists adopted a similar nationalist approach to the question of Koreans in Manchuria. Combining the struggle to liberate Korea with the class struggle in Manchuria, Korean communists assumed uniformity in the national and class subjectivity of Koreans in both Korea and Manchuria. Although the united front of Korean communists and Korean nationalists provided a significant opportunity to suspend the nationalism that had subordinated Manchuria to Korea, Korean communists combined the social issues of Manchuria and the national issue of Korea without exploring their relationship. Both Chinese and Korean communists attempted to reduce the distinctive concerns of Koreans to a homogeneous revolutionary task. The issue of Korean self-rule represented an insupportable separation of Koreans from putatively unified subjects.

zh: 他们的民族主义路径，遮蔽了1932年前后交织朝鲜人与中国人之间民族关系与资本主义关系的满洲特性。满洲的日本帝国主义、资本主义动态与东北政府，把朝鲜与满洲整合进资本主义世界市场，同时再生产财产制度及生产与交换关系方面的差异。无论是东北政府、朝鲜总督府还是满洲国，民族权力都嵌入社会领域。1932年以前，东北政府的民族政策——禁止未加入中国国籍的朝鲜人拥有土地、拒绝向其提供物质援助——组织了地主与佃农之间的资本主义关系。1932年满洲国建立后，朝鲜总督府与满洲国政权新的民族主义动态逆转了朝鲜人与中国人的财产关系，强化了他们之间不平衡的民族与资本主义关系。
en: Their nationalist approaches obscured the Manchurian characteristics that interlaced national and capitalist relations between Koreans and Chinese before and after 1932. Japanese imperialism, capitalist dynamics, and the Northeast government in Manchuria integrated Korea and Manchuria into the capitalist world market while reproducing differences in terms of institutional property systems and the relations of production and exchange. Whether it was the Northeast government, the Government General of Korea, or the Manchukuo, national power was embedded in the social sphere. Prior to 1932, national policies of the Northeast government, which had outlawed landownership by nonnaturalized Koreans and denied them material assistance, organized capitalist relations between landlords and tenants. After the establishment of the Manchukuo state in 1932, a new nationalist dynamics of the Government General of Korea and the Manchukuo state reversed the property relations of Koreans and Chinese, reinforcing the uneven national and capitalist relations between them.

zh: 换言之，朝鲜人与中国人的对立，不仅植根于不同的族群文化风俗，也植根于他们对抗性的财产关系。若要处理满洲条件，抗日革命运动就必须让朝鲜人与中国人根据各自的处境展开斗争。朝鲜人与中国人的社会经验与主体性，不应与朝鲜或中国的经验与主体性同质化。满洲、朝鲜与中国斗争的统一不应被预设。相反，它应通过斗争过程本身形成。然而，朝鲜与中国共产主义者未能充分认识满洲内部朝鲜人处境之间、以及满洲处境与朝鲜或中国处境之间的差异。
en: In other words, the opposition of Koreans and Chinese had been rooted not just in different ethnic and cultural customs but also in their antagonistic property relations. If it were to tackle Manchurian conditions, the anti-Japanese revolutionary movement would have to forge separate struggles for the Koreans and Chinese. The social experiences and subjectivities of Koreans and Chinese were not to be homogenized with those of Korea or China. The unity of the struggle in Manchuria, Korea, and China would not be presupposed. Instead, it would be formed through the process of struggle itself. Yet the Korean and Chinese communists failed to adequately recognize differences among Korean conditions within Manchuria, as well as between conditions in Manchuria and those in Korea or China.

zh: 反民生团斗争的意识形态构型，使朝鲜与中国共产主义者得以缝合其民族主义、对地方条件的社会意识与社会主义国际主义。这场斗争由遮蔽满洲社会生活历史特殊性的民族主义对社会生活的规定所塑造。它意味着中国与朝鲜共产主义者试图逃避这样一种紧张：他们既渴望创造新民族国家，又承诺解决满洲的社会矛盾。斗争试图创造一种新社会秩序——它把民族和阶级想象成同质主体，并在这一框架内建立同质的社会关系。克服朝鲜农民受压迫、建立新独立国家的任务，被从属于进行中国革命这一最高目标。清洗在民生团的幽灵之身中把这种民族欲望人格化。朝鲜与中国共产主义者以两种不相容革命斗争的聚合来构想其社会主义国际主义——这两种斗争旨在朝鲜与中国建构新民族国家。这种特殊的社会主义国际主义以民族方式理解社会关系。它悬置了那种本可把分立的社会斗争结合为世界范围统一革命斗争的不确定辩证法。
en: The ideological figuration of the anti-Minsaengdan struggle enabled Korean and Chinese communists to suture their nationalism, social consciousness of local conditions, and socialist internationalism. The struggle was shaped by national prescriptions for social life that obscured the historical specificities of social life in Manchuria. It signified the attempt of Chinese and Korean communists to elude the tension between their desire to create a new nation-state and their commitment to resolve social contradictions in Manchuria. The struggle attempted to create a new social order—one characterized by homogeneous social relations within the space of essential national and class imaginaries. The tasks of overcoming the oppression of Korean peasants and establishing a new independent state were subordinated to the supreme goal of making the Chinese revolution. The purge personified this national desire in the ghostly body of the Minsaengdan. Korean and Chinese communists envisaged their socialist internationalism in terms of the aggregation of two incompatible revolutionary struggles to construct new nation-states in Korea and China. This particular socialist internationalism understood social relations in national terms. It suspended the indeterminate dialectics that could have combined the separate social struggles in a unified struggle for revolution on a world scale.

zh: 反民生团斗争期间间岛革命斗争的结果是双刃的。一方面，东满特委及其革命单位尽管经历惨烈的内部斗争，仍开展了数量可观的抗日活动。据一份日本报告，游击队1934年发起954次小规模战斗，约201,025名游击队员卷入与日军及满洲国军的184次对抗，为此印发了多达11,040份宣传传单。
另一方面，中共悖论性地以牺牲自己在间岛的革命基础为代价锻造组织霸权。虽然满洲省委党员数从1931年4月的636人增至1931年末的11,000人，却缩减到1933年9月的965人与1935年5月的131人。如果说1931年朝鲜人占党员多数，在这一党员总数普遍下降期间，中国党员增加了10%至20%。朝鲜党员的急剧减少，更多源于反民生团斗争而非日本的平定行动。
中共间岛党员的大幅减少，意味着它在满洲全境即将解体，因为其组织最好、最活跃的单位都在间岛。

en: The outcome of the revolutionary struggle in Kando during the anti-Minsaengdan struggle was double-edged. On the one hand, the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee and its revolutionary units undertook an impressive amount of anti-Japanese activity despite its harrowing internal struggles. According to one Japanese report, guerrillas had launched 954 skirmishes in 1934 in which about 201,025 guerrillas had engaged in 184 confrontations with the Japanese and Manchukuo armies, for which they printed as many as 11,040 propaganda leaflets.

On the other hand, the ccp paradoxically crafted its organizational hegemony at the expense of its own revolutionary base in Kando. Although the number of mpc members increased from 636 in April 1931 to 11,000 in late 1931, it shrank to 965 in September 1933 and 131 in May 1935. If Koreans comprised the majority of the membership in 1931, the Chinese members increased by 10 to 20 percent during this general decline in membership. The drastic reduction in Korean membership resulted more from the anti-Minsaengdan struggle than Japanese pacification.
The substantial decrease in ccp membership in Kando meant its imminent dissolution in the whole of Manchuria because its best-organized and most active units were in Kando.

zh: 随着革命力量的混乱与朝鲜人阵营支持的萎缩，满洲省委1935年年中重新评估了斗争。不必要的残酷、革命力量的士气低落与朝鲜群众的疏离受到谴责。此外，满洲省委内部的批评者开始斥责东满特委忽视朝鲜群众的两大关切——解放朝鲜与满洲朝鲜人自治。虽然把朝鲜人划为少数族群的民族主义做法继续盛行，如今却提议在间岛建立朝鲜人自治的特别区。还建议教育群众认清中共的朝鲜人自治政策与日本及流亡朝鲜人类似政策之间的区别。
en: With the disarray of the revolutionary forces and the dwindling support of the Korean constituency, the mpc reassessed the struggle in the middle of 1935. Unnecessary brutality, demoralization of the revolutionary forces, and alienation of the Korean masses were condemned. Moreover, critics within the mpc began to rebuke the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee for ignoring two concerns of the Korean masses—the liberation of Korea and Korean self-rule in Manchuria. Although the nationalist codification of Koreans as the minority continued to prevail, the establishment of a special district for self-rule by Koreans in Kando was now proposed. The education of the masses on the difference between the policy of the ccp on Korean self-rule and a similar policy of Japan and exiled Koreans was also recommended.

zh: 1936年，满洲省委发布新决议，终止反民生团斗争，却没有为形成新的社会认识提供条件。决议重新配置了朝鲜与中国共产主义者联盟的性质。但间岛朝鲜人自治问题未获展开。决议重组中国革命军队，把负责中国革命与解放朝鲜的单位分开。随着满洲省委放弃间岛游击根据地，其人民解放军于1936年移往南满与北满。此外，满洲省委组织了一个专门致力于解放朝鲜斗争的特别单位，完全由朝鲜人组成。这支东满第二革命军后来改称抗日联军第一路军第二军。中共重组其革命军队，允许朝鲜共产主义者与游击部队专注于解放朝鲜的任务。虽然有过按民族界线组织军队的讨论，这一提议却遭到满洲省委某些部门的反对，尤其是北满委员会。
取而代之，抗日联军第一路军第二军第六师在金日成领导下主要由朝鲜人组成，获准在东边道，即奉天省与朝鲜北部之间的边界地带，集中开展争取朝鲜解放的斗争，并对朝鲜境内的日本人发动攻击。1940年代初，金日成及其朝鲜与中国同志退入苏联。

en: In 1936, the mpc issued a new resolution that terminated the anti-Minsaengdan struggle, though without authorizing a new social consciousness. The resolution reconfigured the nature of the coalition between Korean and Chinese communists. But the issue of self-rule of Koreans in Kando was not elaborated. The resolution reshuffled the Chinese revolutionary armies, separating units in charge of the Chinese revolution and the liberation of Korea. As the mpc gave up guerrilla bases in Kando, its People’s Liberation Armies moved to South and North Manchuria in 1936. Moreover, the mpc organized a special unit devoted to the struggle to liberate Korea, consisting exclusively of Koreans. This Second Eastern Manchuria Revolutionary Army was later renamed the Second Army of the First Route Army of the Anti-Japanese United Forces. The ccp reorganized its revolutionary armies, permitting Korean communists and guerrilla forces to attend to the task of liberating Korea. Although there was some discussion about organizing the armies along ethnic lines, this proposal was opposed by some sections of the mpc, especially the Northern Manchurian Committee.

Instead, the Sixth Division of the Second Army of the First Route Army of the Anti-Japanese United Forces, which under the leadership of Kim Il Sung was comprised mainly of Koreans, was given permission to concentrate its efforts on liberating Korea in the Tongbyŏndo area—the border area between Fengtian Province and northern Korea—and launching attacks on the Japanese in Korea. Kim Il Sung and his Korean and Chinese comrades retreated to the Soviet Union in the early 1940s.

zh: 中共革命军队的改编，标志着朝鲜人争取本国独立的斗争与中国革命总任务之间一次迟来的协调。但这种接近仍受持续的中国民族主义限制。如果说反民生团斗争由相互冲突的朝鲜与中国共产主义者的领土化民族主义所驱动，那么斗争的终止并未结束、反而强化了以民族主义方式对待社会主义国际主义的路径。例如，吴（Wu）是满洲省委内部对这场斗争最直言不讳的批评者之一，他由中共满洲省委派往满洲观察局势，指责这场斗争把阶级斗争置于与解放朝鲜斗争相对立的位置。
这一自我批评绕过了中共的两副面孔：把阶级斗争预设为普遍利益，以及采纳民族主义。东满特委书记重申中国民族主义，断言“除非中国人成为人民解放军的主要构成，否则不会有大的改善”。
他把中国人人口集中但尚未建立农业合作社的地区认定为游击根据地的理想地点。当他建议放弃间岛游击根据地、理由是那里已不再有“人民”时，他必定是在暗示朝鲜人已经离去。然而“人民”也可能指“中国人”——他们在间岛根据地大体缺席或无声。
en: The reformation of the ccp revolutionary armies signified an overdue rapprochement between the Korean struggle for the independence of Korea and the general task of the Chinese revolution. But the rapprochement was limited by continued Chinese nationalism. If the anti-Minsaengdan struggle was driven by the territorializing nationalism of Korean and Chinese communists in conflict, the termination of the struggle did not end but only bolstered the nationalist approach to socialist internationalism. For instance, Wu, one of the most outspoken critics of the struggle within the mpc, who was sent to observe the situation in Manchuria by the Manchurian Provincial Committee of the ccp, charged the struggle with positing class struggle in opposition to the struggle to liberate Korea.

Bypassed in this self-criticism were the two faces of the ccp: the supposition of class struggle as a universal interest and the adoption of nationalism. Reinvoking Chinese nationalism, the secretary of the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee asserted that “unless the Chinese become the main constituents of the people’s liberation armies, there will be no major improvement.”

He identified areas where the Chinese population was concentrated but agrarian cooperatives had not been established as ideal for guerrilla bases. When he suggested abandoning the guerrilla bases of Kando, as they no longer had any “people,” he must have been indicating that the Koreans had deserted. Yet the “people” might have also meant the “Chinese,” who were largely absent or voiceless in the Kando bases.

zh: 中国或朝鲜民族主义在满洲的一个陷阱，是丧失批判资本主义的空间。民族主义提供了朝鲜与中国共产主义者用来理解满洲人民社会处境的视角。民族主义折射出一种革命时间观，使当地的特定历史处境失去分量。例如，朝鲜共产主义者对间岛朝鲜农民社会经验的理解，即便没有被吸纳进一个想象的民族实体，至多也凝固在看似超时间的资产阶级自治观念之中。朝鲜共产主义者对自治的暧昧认可，与普遍财产所有权和个人自由的问题纠缠在一起。被遮蔽的是社会关系中的地区与民族差异——这种差异无法被阶级斗争或抗日统一战线的诉求一扫而空。
en: A pitfall of Chinese or Korean nationalism in Manchuria was the loss of space for critiques of capitalism. Nationalism supplied an optic through which Korean and Chinese communists interpreted the social conditions of people in Manchuria. In the refracted vision of nationalism, historical specificity was emptied at the moment of revolutionary time. For instance, Korean communists’ understanding of the social experiences of the Korean peasants of Kando was at best frozen in the seemingly timeless bourgeois idea of self-rule, if it was not absorbed into an imagined national entity. Korean communists’ ambiguous endorsement of self-rule was tangled up with the issues of universal rights of property ownership and individual freedom. Obscured was the regional and national disparity in social relations, which could not be swept away by the appeal for class struggle or the anti-Japanese united front.

zh: 总之，共产主义者的民族主义视角把人民化为单一主体，既是阶级主体，也是民族主体。阶级主体的形成嵌入民族国家形成之中，后者抹除了不同地点与时间的农民群体在族群、民族与社会上的异质性。朝鲜与中国共产主义者的民族叙事召唤农民——无论其族群与民族身份如何，都被假定共享一连串压迫：从难以承受的地租、剥削性高利贷、赋税与市场垄断，到帝国主义日益加剧的支配。反过来，将人群划分为多数与少数的做法把中国与朝鲜农民构想为民族主体，把他们整合进反帝斗争的集体梦想。
en: In sum, the national optics of the communists contrived the singularity of people as both class and national subjects. The formation of class subjects was embedded in nation-state formation, which obliterated the ethnic, national, and social heterogeneity of peasant groups in different places and times. The national narratives of the Korean and Chinese communists invoked the peasants, who were presumed, regardless of their ethnic and national identities, to share a litany of oppression, ranging from unbearable rents, exploitative usury, taxes, and market monopoly to the intensifying domination of the imperialists. In turn, the codification of majority and minority conceived Chinese and Korean peasants as national subjects, integrating them into a collective dream of anti-imperialist struggle.

zh: 满洲的社会关系是一个通过民族政治的运作表现出来的全球性问题。当日本帝国主义主导的资本主义动态把满洲与朝鲜及世界整合起来时，资本也借各地的民族特殊性，利用满洲、朝鲜与世界其他地区在工资、技能、劳动力与资源上的差距来牟利。这种不平衡要求满洲开展不同于朝鲜或中国的特定斗争。虽然这并不排除承认与他人的统一，但这种统一不应被预设，而应通过斗争过程锻造。然而，间岛的斗争要么通过唤起朝鲜人的族群身份而被纳入解放朝鲜的斗争，要么通过诉诸朝鲜人在满洲与中国的少数地位而被纳入进行中国革命的斗争。当朝鲜共产主义者把满洲构想为朝鲜民族的空间时，他们认为满洲斗争与中国革命的缔造相互排斥。当他们加入中共并谴责自己解放朝鲜的斗争时，他们又反转立场，把满洲斗争与中国革命的形成混为一谈。满洲的社会主义国际主义因此至多被化约为两场分立民族革命的合并，或一场被另一场吸收。
en: Social relations in Manchuria were a global problem mediated by national dynamics. While capitalist dynamics spearheaded by Japanese imperialism integrated Manchuria with Korea and the world, they also drew on national uniqueness to exploit disparities among Manchuria, Korea, and other parts of the world in levels of wages, skills, labor power, and resources. Such unevenness demanded a specific struggle in Manchuria different from those in Korea or China. Although it would not preclude the recognition of unity with others, such unity must not be presupposed but forged through the process of struggle. However, the struggle in Kando was subsumed either to the struggle to liberate Korea by invoking ethnic identities of Koreans, or to the struggle to make the Chinese revolution by appealing to Korean’s minority status in Manchuria and China. When Korean communists conjured Manchuria as a space of the Korean nation, they perceived the Manchurian struggle to be mutually exclusive to the making of the Chinese revolution. When they joined the ccp and denounced their struggle to liberate Korea, they reversed their position to conflate the Manchurian struggle with the formation of the Chinese revolution. Socialist internationalism in Manchuria was thus reduced to the amalgamation of two separate national revolutions at best or the absorption of one by the other.

zh: 北朝鲜革命的起源
en: the origins of the north korean revolution

zh: 从日本统治下解放后，朝鲜共产主义者在满洲的经验变成了一幕极为奇特的景观：北朝鲜革命的起源。据统治北朝鲜至少四十年的金日成及其同志所言，他们在满洲的经历为其革命奠定了基础。解放后，金日成集团与其他返回朝鲜的流亡集团会合，包括曾在苏联与中国本部从事共产主义活动的苏联派与延安派。1950年代末夺取权力后，金日成集团把1930年代满洲斗争的经验提升为北朝鲜国家的官方意识形态——主体（juch'e，自力更生）思想。自此，满洲斗争的记忆驻留在北朝鲜政治文化的核心，对其经济、政治与文化活动的一切方面施加影响。武装斗争的各种回忆录与追述在北朝鲜社会的学校、工作场所、社区与政治单位中被讲授。
鉴于满洲在北朝鲜政治与文化中无处不在，理解北朝鲜需要把握满洲与北朝鲜革命之间的关联。
en: After liberation from Japanese rule, the Korean communist experience in Manchuria turned into a most peculiar spectacle: the origin of the North Korean revolution. According to Kim Il Sung and his comrades, who governed North Korea for at least four decades, their Manchurian experience laid the foundation for their revolution. After liberation, Kim Il Sung’s group joined other exiled groups that returned to Korea, including the Soviet and Yenan groups, which had engaged in communist activities in the Soviet Union and China proper. After seizing power in the late 1950s, Kim Il Sung’s group elevated the experience of the Manchurian struggle of the 1930s to the North Korean state’s official ideology of juch’e (self-reliance). Since then, the memory of the Manchurian struggle has been lodged in the heart of the political culture of North Korea, exerting its influence in all aspects of economic, political, and cultural activities. Various memoirs and recollections of the armed struggle were taught in schools, workplaces, communities, and political units of North Korean society.

Given the ubiquitous presence of Manchuria in North Korean politics and culture, an understanding of North Korea requires comprehension of the linkages between Manchuria and the North Korean revolution.

zh: 北朝鲜革命研究的一个主要焦点，是关于满洲抗日斗争的说法是否属实。金日成的行踪尤其令历史学家关注，因为包括韩国威权国家在内的保守派一直把他的宣称斥为虚假。和田春树（Wada Haruki）提供了金日成最全面的年谱之一，平息了大部分疑虑。从正义府经营的一所中学毕业后，他于1929年参加朝鲜共产主义青年会（Chosŏn kongsan ch'ŏngnyŏnhoe），该会支持正义府与国民府。他加入朝鲜革命军（Chosŏn Hyŏngmyŏnggun）。加入中共后，他及其游击队于1933年并入中共东满特委的汪清游击队。他被任命为该军政治委员（Chŏngch'i wiwŏn）。

children: 〔校注〕原文英文将职衔释为政治委员会成员，所附朝鲜语转写 Chŏngch’i wiwŏn 则指政治委员，译文从后者。

en: A primary focus of the study of the North Korean revolution has been the veracity of the claim of anti-Japanese struggle in Manchuria. The whereabouts of Kim Il Sung have been of especially keen interest for historians, as conservatives, including the authoritarian states in South Korea, have discounted his claims as false. Quelling most of the doubts, Wada Haruki has provided one of the most comprehensive chronologies of Kim Il Sung. After graduating from a middle school operated by the Chŏngŭibu, he participated in the Korean Communist Youth Association (Chosŏn kongsan ch’ŏngnyŏnhoe) in 1929, which supported the Chonguibu and the League of Koreans. He joined the Korean Revolutionary Army (Chosŏn Hyŏngmyŏnggun). After joining the ccp, he and his guerrilla army joined the unit of the Wangch’ong guerrilla army of the Eastern Manchurian Special Committee of the ccp in 1933. He was appointed as a member of the Committee for Political Affairs (Chŏngch’i wiwŏn) of the army.

zh: 反民生团斗争期间，金日成一度被指控为民生团间谍。据金成镐（Kim Songho）的分析，金日成获释可归因于他与中共领导人的密切关系及流利的汉语。

为促成斗争的结束，金日成烧毁了把该军约一百名新成员诬陷为民生团成员的档案。斗争期间，他的部队于1934年10月至1935年末两次远征北满。1936年，中共把东北人民革命军第二军改编为东北抗日联军时，金日成被任命为其第三部队的指挥员。1936年末，他派遣共产主义者回朝鲜组织祖国光复会（Choguk kwangbokhoe）。直到1940年代初逃往苏联，他持续在满洲与朝鲜两地与日本警察和军队发生小规模交火。
en: During the anti-Minsaengdan struggle, Kim Il Sung was once charged with being a Minsaengdan spy. According to Kim Songho’s analysis, the release of Kim is attributable to his close relations with Chinese communist leaders and his fluency in Chinese.

Contributing to ending the struggle, Kim burned documents that framed about one hundred new members of this army as Minsaengdan members. During the struggle, his army launched two expeditions to North Manchuria between October 1934 and the end of 1935. In 1936, when the ccp transformed the Second Army of the Northeast People’s Revolutionary Army into the Northeast Anti-Japanese United Army, Kim was appointed the leader of its Third Unit. In late 1936, he dispatched communists to Korea to organize the Federation to Liberate the Fatherland (Choguk kwangbokhoe). Until his escape to the Soviet Union in the early 1940s, he continued to engage in skirmishes with the Japanese police and armies in both Manchuria and Korea.

zh: Lee Chongsŏk 的论文是韩国学界对满洲经验与北朝鲜国家的首项研究，它指出前者对后者的三项塑造作用：涵盖多样政治阵营、以便在解放后时期创建统一国家的民族统一战线；把土地分配给农民的土地改革；以及把动员群众、改善群众境遇放在首位。
在北朝鲜政治中，党与群众的关系被比作鱼水关系。群众被视为关于满洲斗争的官方历史叙述中不可或缺的角色。本书对民族主义与社会关系的分析表明，群众政治的历史遗产有其自身的限度。朝鲜人之间的民族统一战线与中国的社会主义国际主义，都陷入领土化民族主义——对朝鲜与中国共产主义者而言，它构成了理解群众社会条件的障碍。
en: Lee Chongsok’s thesis, the first South Korean study of the Manchurian experience and the North Korean state, identifies three major constitutive effects of the former on the latter: the national united front that encompassed diverse political camps so as to create a unified state in the postliberation period, the land reforms that distributed land to peasants, and the priority given to mobilizing and benefiting the masses.

In North Korean politics, the relationship between the party and the masses is compared to the relationship between fish and water. The masses are regarded as indispensable elements in the truth of the Manchurian struggle. The analysis of nationalism and social relations in this book suggests that the historical legacy of mass politics entailed its own limits. The national united front among Koreans and socialist internationalism in China was caught up in territorializing nationalism, which for both Korean and Chinese communists presented barriers to understanding the social conditions of the masses.

zh: 满洲多面向的朝鲜历史表明，朝鲜政治与抗日革命运动在目标、领导者和群众基础上各不相同。朝鲜农民经历着因地区与时间而异的社会关系，与中国农民形成复杂的关系。朝鲜与中国共产主义者的社会主义国际主义偏离了全球统一的理想。满洲经验的记忆，体现了朝鲜群众与共产主义者为民族与社会主义事业而未实现的统一。从满洲斗争的记忆中被切除的，是群众社会生活与社会主义民族政治之间不可化约的裂隙。对清洗及随后满洲抗日斗争重组的分析，揭示了群众政治的民族史——它在北朝鲜民族主义史学中被深深压抑。本书试图把北朝鲜对满洲斗争的建构，置于民族主义、帝国主义、资本主义与一种特殊形式的社会主义国际主义的复杂历史之中。
en: The multifaceted Korean history in Manchuria shows that Korean politics and anti-Japanese revolutionary movements were anything but unified in terms of their objectives, leadership, and constituencies. Korean peasants experienced social relations that differed by region and over time, developing complex relationships with their Chinese counterparts. The socialist internationalism of the Korean and Chinese communists deviated from the ideal of global unity. The memory of the Manchurian experience embodies the unfulfilled unity of the Korean masses and communists for national and socialist causes. Excised from the memory of the Manchurian struggle is the irreducible gap between the masses’ social life and socialist national politics. The analysis of the purge and the subsequent reorganization of the anti-Japanese struggle in Manchuria shed light on the national history of mass politics, which has been deeply repressed in the historiography of North Korean nationalism. This book attempts to situate the North Korean construction of the Manchurian struggle within the complex history of nationalism, imperialism, capitalism, and a particular form of socialist internationalism.

For the thesis of scapegoating and national discrimination, see Kim Sŏngho, 1930 nyŏndae Yŏnbyŏn Minsaengdan sagŏn yŏn’gu (The Minsaengdan Incident in Yanbian in the 1930s) (Seoul: Paeksan Charyowŏn, 1999). For the argument that the purge originated in Chinese nationalism, see Lee Chongsŏk, “Pukhan chido chiptankwa hangil mujang t’ujaeng,” 35–154; and Shin Chubaek, Manju chiyŏk Haninŭi minjok undongsa (1920–45). For the history of the Korean Communist Party in English, see Robert Scalapino and Lee Chong Sik, Communism in Korea, Part I (Berkeley: University of California Press, 1972); and Suh, Dae-sook, The Korean Communist Movement, 1918–1948 (Princeton: Princeton University Press, 1967).

en: The Minsaengdan was influenced by the self-rule movement in Korea, which aspired to modernize the country and create a form of autonomy comparable to what Canada had realized under British rule. In Korea, the movement for self-rule emerged in the 1930s as a controversial nationalist project. According to its proponents, it was a nationalist movement modeled after colonies in the European empire that had gained some autonomy.

en: For Korean noncommunist groups and their alliances with Korean communists in forging the united front, see Shin Chubaek, Manju chiyŏk Haninŭi minjok undongsa (1920–45), 76–96. For various organizations such as the Tamuldang, Koryŏ hyŏngmyŏngdang, and Han’guk nodongdang, see 108–28. For the conflicts between communists and the Sinminbu, see Kim Ch’unsŏn, “Sinminbuŭi haech’e” (The Dissolution of the Sinminbu), in Chungguk Chosŏn minjok palchach’wi ch’ongsŏ, vol. 2, Pulssi, 222; and Lee Kanghun, “Kongsandange amsaltanghan Kim Chwajin changgunuŭi ch’oehu” (The Last of General Kim Chwajin, Assassinated by Communists), Pukhan (North Korea) (1984): 198–207. The Japanese general consul claimed that the Sinminbu extorted money from Koreans through threats and violence in the name of Korean national liberation. For a discussion of the Sinminbu, see Kim Ch’unsŏn, “ Hanjok ch’ong yŏnhaphoe” (The Korean Federation), in Chungguk Chosŏn minjok palchach’wi ch’ongsŏ, vol. 2, Pulssi, 232–40.
